map.[hota] headhunting.quest.69.0.1.firs: I have something, but for Altera only, and no one else.
map.[hota] headhunting.sign.13.17.1.mess: Raiding anywhere at any time for your money.
map.[hota] headhunting.town.39.0.1.name: LetMeFly
map.[hota] headhunting.town.70.43.1.name: Eaglyre
map.[hota] help!.event.0.description:
All your life you'd dreamt of being the one to find the Grail, but a lord's duties left little time for dreams. Then one night a stranger in a dark alley told you that the Grail was buried in a secluded forest a month's ride away. 

He must'd weaved some spellwork into his words, because you left that same night. Your trusty old steward was to manage things in your absence.
map.[hota] help!.event.1.description:
As you return to your land in deep trouble you feel as if a curse struck the moment you left. Your steward, half-buried in frantic missives and letters entailing cries for help, is glad to have you back.

Curiously, you learn that not only did your rival lords vanish on the same night as you did; their territories are no better off than yours right now.
map.[hota] help!.event.2.description:
Nestled between angry letters and dire tax reports you spot a clear-white envelope adorned with the sigil of a golden hare. It's a letter from the seer Jamison, who lives near the lands of the Necromancers.

Hastily written, it says that he will visit soon with important news. Until then he advises you to beware of a man named Sandro and seek out the Obelisks strewn across your lands.
map.[hota] help!.event.3.description:
The seer Jamison arrives with a heap of answers. That Necromancer Sandro is behind it all. He lured you away and sowed chaos as a distraction so he could freely scour the lands.

What for? As it turns out, the Grail was buried here all along! Solving the riddle of the Obelisks will reveal its precise spot. Maybe your old dream will come true after all.
map.[hota] help!.event.4.description:
As he turns to leave the seer Jamison tells you that fairness compels him to inform your rivals too. That makes it a five-way race for the Grail, including Sandro who the seer suspects is still out there, searching.

You welcome the challenge. And who knows? Maybe somewhere along the road you may even run into Sandro and have your chance to get back at him.
map.[hota] help!.event.5.description:
What if it's actually a curse? You never saw the stranger's face... Could the four of you have fallen for one man's nefarious scheme? If so, why did he lure you away and impose misfortune upon your lands?

Maybe in time you'll find answers to these questions. Until then you have your work cut out for you. Restoring the flow of resources should be your top priority.
map.[hota] help!.guards.0.67.0.message: Richly adorned, the box displays the sigil of a golden rabbit, encircled by silvery words. They read: "All the world will be your enemy, Prince with a Thousand Enemies, and whenever they catch you, they will kill you. But first they must catch you."
map.[hota] help!.guards.102.15.1.message: Cries in the dark draw you to a camp of Kobold miners encircled by fire-breathing salamanders. While prepared for this cavern's heat, they didn't account for its wildlife, and upon their rescue elect to enter your ranks. You learn that they're from the eastern ice tunnels, where Vori exilants live.
map.[hota] help!.guards.103.44.0.message: A local fisherman who supports your cause gifts you a golden hermit crab shell. As all shells do, it evokes the sea waves when you hold it to your ear, but beyond that also emits a mysterious murmur. Written down, it turns out to be a magic formula for a spell of the high seas.
map.[hota] help!.guards.105.10.0.message: By a stone circle several astrologers have gathered to argue over the infinitesimal flux in the lengths of day and night that occurs through a year. Most deem it trivial, while one firebrand proposes eight days a week rather than seven. You move on none the wiser, though wisened in time’s endless mystery.
map.[hota] help!.guards.107.57.0.message: Richly adorned, the box displays the sigil of a golden whale, encircled by silvery words. They read: "In this world, sin that pays its way can travel freely and without a passport; whereas Virtue, if a pauper, is stopped at all frontiers."
map.[hota] help!.guards.14.57.1.message: There once was a thief named Silverclaw who, always on the run, scattered his wealth across dozens of hidden caches all over the world. He then put a mind spell on these caches, making them invisible for those who are searching for them – and as it so happens, you weren't just then.
map.[hota] help!.guards.15.5.0.message: After the wide-scale exodus of the Conflux many Pixies began to scour the wilds for traces of their lost masters. You run into one such searching party from the southern Elemental keep of Llacielo, and by pledging to join the search attain their allegiance.
map.[hota] help!.guards.16.33.1.message: Your scouts tip you off about a golden lion who's been stalking the rearguard for some hours. To turn the tables, you lie in wait and ambush what turns out to be a fiendish mugger masquerading as the imposing beast. You relieve him of his golden fur hide as well as his ill-earned coin.
map.[hota] help!.guards.16.92.1.message: A troupe of mimes entertains your troops with their play of being helplessly trapped behind invisible walls. Sensing their magical skill, you invite them to a round of ale and eventually charm them into betraying the secret behind their illusion – which, as it turns out, was no illusion at all.
map.[hota] help!.guards.2.51.0.message: Atop the dunes a desert nomad plays the flute, evoking beautiful harmonies. Around him the sand takes shape – spirals, waves, even faces – as if it were alive and entranced by the music. You’ve heard rumors of these so-called sand charmers and seize the chance to learn their technique.
map.[hota] help!.guards.20.93.0.message: Pausing to rest under a haggard old oak, you dream of a knight in black armor who without saying a word draws his blade and waits for your opening strike. Your victory is hard-fought, but you feel stronger for it. When you finally strike him down you jolt awake and see that the oak has returned to full bloom.
map.[hota] help!.guards.22.55.0.message: You’re approached by a Dread Knight who asks you to join his hunt for his killer – a golden scorpion. Together, you track down the tiny, yet deadly fiend and slay it, whereupon the Dread Knight departs for the afterlife, leaving you his blade. While no match for the scorpion’s sting, it still has a formidable bite.
map.[hota] help!.guards.24.13.0.message: Whispers in the wind speak of a secret shrine to Cloud Nedlon, patron saint of voyagers, hidden somewhere in these wind-swept hills. After some time, you wonder if the wind itself embodies the shrine – no matter which way you turn, it’s always in your back, gently pushing you forward.
map.[hota] help!.guards.25.104.0.message: In the skies you spy a gold-feathered magpie and, recalling their habit of stealing coin, trail its flight to a cliffside nest. Making your way up, you find a hoard fit for a master thief, from which you take the gold but leave the golden eggs – courtesy from one thief to another.
map.[hota] help!.guards.28.45.1.message: Richly adorned, the box displays the sigil of a golden beetle, encircled by silvery words. They read: "Heaven is for Thee too high to know what passes there; be lowly wise. Think only what concerns Thee and Thy being. Dream not of other worlds."
map.[hota] help!.guards.33.39.1.message: A quartet of undead bards who wouldn't let death get in the way of their love for performing invites your army to their roadside show. Despite their constitution, they're infectiously lively – even the nearby deadwoods start to sprout new buds as if revived by their rousing vigor.
map.[hota] help!.guards.33.91.1.message: A frenzied horse races past you, its rider holding on for dear life. Once you’ve helped him rein it in, he blames the magic horseshoe that he spent a fortune on, believing himself swindled. You pry it off the poor mare’s hoof and tell the man he’s half-right – it’s enchanted, just not as he thought.
map.[hota] help!.guards.34.32.0.message: A stir in the tall grass draws you to a gold-spined hedgehog entrapped in a hunter’s snare. Once you’ve lent the odd critter a hand, it claws off one of its spines and drops it at your feet before scuttling off. You pick it up and find it blessed with the hedgehog’s hardy spirit.
map.[hota] help!.guards.35.70.0.message: Worn down by heavy snowfall, your troops strike up an old marching song about a princess who became a dragon to scare off her suitors, only for one brave fool to pursue her anyway. While predictably ending on a grisly note, the song rekindles your army’s will to push on.
map.[hota] help!.guards.37.59.1.message: You meet a crew of old spelunkers on a quest for a legendary golden owl. Their hunt has led them to all four corners of the world and shown them many great wonders, if not the one desired. Sympathetic to your own quest, they share their tales with you before moving on.
map.[hota] help!.guards.37.78.1.message: You're alerted to several Troglodytes hungrily rifling through your supply wagon. Ultimately, they turn out to be not bandits but ill-mannered emissaries sent by the western Warlocks to ask for your help in defending their territory. To keep the Troglodytes from raiding yours, your supply master insists they tag along.
map.[hota] help!.guards.41.23.1.message: You meet a travelling She-Demon who appears thoroughly unfazed by the freezing cold, for which she credits her years under Sir Hammer of Silver Cove, a master of Body Magic. Upon your curiosity she gifts you her notes on how to steel one's body against ills – be it weather or warfare.
map.[hota] help!.guards.47.56.0.message: A sparring tourney is held amongst the many suitors of a nobleman’s daughter. Rather than facing the masked mystery knight who so far stays unbeaten, you approach him in private and compliment the girl on her disguise as well as her skill. Grateful for your silence, she gifts you a bag of her father’s coin.
map.[hota] help!.guards.48.2.0.message: There once was a lord who was good-hearted but a weak ruler, so his men overthrew him and destroyed his statues, save for the torsos so as not to punish his good heart within. A wayside shrine holds one such relic doused in thyme smell and candlelight – history must’ve been kinder on him than his kin.
map.[hota] help!.guards.53.105.0.message: It is midday when you come upon a tall sun dial whose shadow mysteriously points to the hour of sunset as if it were transfixed in time. After studying the dial for a while – wherein its shadow never moves – you identify and remove the seal that had stifled it, restoring it to time’s true rhythm.
map.[hota] help!.guards.54.92.0.message: Inspired by an old folktale of Lord Tell the Sharp, your soldiers have taken to trying to shoot apples off each other’s heads. The challenge grows popular, as do visits to the healer’s tent. You’re about to chastise those involved when a scholar in your employ draws from old books a far better solution.
map.[hota] help!.guards.55.21.0.message: You run into a postman who, sensing your competitive spirit, challenges you to a footrace. He beats you handily, for which he credits his magic amulet that he pawned off a peddler, who in turn found it in an eagle’s nest. Just like its carriers, it seems destined to travel a lot, so you’re up next.
map.[hota] help!.guards.55.71.0.message: Wrecked ashore lies a bright-yellow dhow which, judging by the many maps, drawings and journals that you find below deck, must have sailed a great share of the Five Seas before its unceremonious end. As its crew is nowhere to be found, you plunder the wreck for its scholarly worth.
map.[hota] help!.guards.57.8.1.message: A golden ermine darts past you, chased by a frenzied warrior. You decide to aid not the hunter but the prey which, after catching its breath, transforms into a young waif who admits to having nabbed the warrior’s coin. Since you’re partners in crime now, you get your fair share.
map.[hota] help!.guards.58.35.0.message: In their nightly leisure your soldiers have started to organize makeshift theatre plays based on old fairytales as well as, to your pride, your own exploits and battles. Last night you attended one such play which gave you no small delight, but also a new point of view on your past.
map.[hota] help!.guards.6.45.1.message: A travelling circus dubbed the Magical Mystery Tour shows off various purported relics of the Ancients that turn out to be neither magical nor mysterious but fakes, safe for one – a broken blaster. While it no longer functions, you manage to extract its battery, a crystal of arcane power.
map.[hota] help!.guards.6.8.1.message: In the dark you come upon a lost and feeble maiden who, as your healers tend to her, recalls being kidnapped by a Vampire before the fiend was in turn struck by a golden flurry. Whoever it was who saved her, you did your part as well, so she gifts you all her rings and jewelry.
map.[hota] help!.guards.67.101.1.message: Out of nowhere colorful tents and stalls materialize before you – it’s the Market of Time, which shows only once in a blue moon. While your soldiers shop for otherworldly baubles and souvenirs, you strike up a deal with a merchant, telling him all that transpired since their last visit in trade for a rare tome of wisdom.
map.[hota] help!.guards.67.103.0.message: By a depleted ore mine you meet a trio of quarrymen who, freshly out of work, built from chisels, pans and mattocks a clever set of pipes, drums and cymbals, and while they barely hit a right note, their ingenuity shines through. Moving on, your soldiers still hum their tunes to themselves.
map.[hota] help!.guards.67.56.0.message: Rather than settling for hardtack and dried jerky, your soldiers go hunting in the woods and jubilantly return with a slain golden boar. While listening to the tale of their adventure, you try a bite of the cooked meat – it’s oddly pungent, as if infused with the beast’s raw fury.
map.[hota] help!.guards.68.56.1.message: A travelling actor presents to you his brand new play based on a script which he found in a pyramid. You're still trying to get the gist of the plot when the actor suddenly explodes in a fiery blaze. In the ashes you find miraculously unscathed what he mistook for a script and realize his error.
map.[hota] help!.guards.70.34.1.message: Richly adorned, the box displays the sigil of a golden wolf, encircled by silvery words. They read: "The Jackal may follow the Tiger, but, Cub, when thy whiskers are grown, remember the Wolf is a Hunter — go forth and get food of thine own."
map.[hota] help!.guards.70.74.0.message: A passing-by carnival acquaints you with a mysterious songstress whose alluring voice evokes wind-swept seas and the crash of the surf, from which you snap out of just as she goes for your purse. Put at sword-point, the Siren drops her act and offers her skillset in return for your mercy.
map.[hota] help!.guards.70.79.1.message: In the damp and dark cavern air fireflies glow all around you like stars at night – one as brilliant as golden Polaris, the North Star. Your soldiers go about catching it, but you tell them off, a kindness the golden bug returns by guiding your trek for a while, lighting the trail ahead.
map.[hota] help!.guards.72.10.0.message: When your scouts report a dragon down the trail you scramble to mount a defense, but the foe quickly turns out to be a sheep in wolf's clothing, or rather a harmless scholar whose disguise was only meant to deter bandits. Grateful to you for staying your hand, he shares his spellcraft with you.
map.[hota] help!.guards.75.22.1.message: You halt by a statue of Temper, Lady of Fire, and ask for a swift and sound passage through her domain. Soon after, you're rattled by closeby earthquakes and volcanic rumblings – Temper's scornful rebuff or, as it drives your troops to make haste, her backhanded way of answering your prayer.
map.[hota] help!.guards.77.40.1.message: Under the skeletal trees a ghostly figure beckons you towards the remains of an adventurer. The ghost pleads with you to gather his bones and bury them where the sun shines, offering his armor in return. It's dented where the killing blow struck, but otherwise in good condition.
map.[hota] help!.guards.8.106.1.message: Scribbled in the scroll's corner is a handwritten note from Sandro: apparently he was planning to use the Water Walk spell to hasten his eventual return to Deyja. No matter how the scroll found its way here, it's now yours.
map.[hota] help!.guards.87.102.1.message: A martial arts tourney is held in honor of Vim, the Rock-Axe. You try your luck at splitting a stone in two with your bare hands but quickly learn that you’re better off sticking to traditional weaponry. The wise old tourney master, however, commends your attempt – after all, failure is the best teacher.
map.[hota] help!.guards.88.51.1.message: A man is thrown to your feet, still clutching the Spyglass he had on him when caught nearby. He denies being a spy and instead speaks of a vision commanding him to find among all grail-seekers the chosen one. Telling him to look no further, you relieve him of his device.
map.[hota] help!.guards.89.51.0.message: You meet a free-spirited Elf maiden who, upon a prophecy that a knight in shining armor would sweep her off her feet, fashioned a set of sturdy greaves so that may never happen. You explain the prophecy’s true meaning to her, whereupon she unburdens herself from the greaves and gives them to you.
map.[hota] help!.guards.90.74.1.message: A winged desert sphinx lands before you, curious what brought you to her domain. What you call Grail, she knows as Ark of the Everserpent, said to hold the bones of the first dragon-pharaoh. Still, she deems your quest a noble one, and by flapping her great wings bestows to you favorable winds.
map.[hota] help!.guards.95.29.0.message: Legend says that all forest birds used to sing one and the same song before creating their varied melodies. A travelling piper who claims to have learned this ancient ur-song accompanies you for a while, and whether or not the story is true, his music makes your trek light as feathers.
map.[hota] help!.guards.98.65.0.message: A young and aspiring bard on tour offers your soldiers a showcase of his talents, debuting a song he wrote himself. Unfortunately, he is abysmal, and your dispirited troops crossly chase him off. In his haste he drops his music sheet, which may still be of use – in a roundabout way.
map.[hota] help!.guards.99.88.0.message: You encounter several Goblins of the upper wilds hacking away at a large dark boulder. They tell you that tavern buzz about priceless Black Gold drove them south, and while they‘re crushed to learn of their misunderstanding, they surmise that their best chance at finding the real deal lies in joining you.
map.[hota] help!.header.description: You're searching far-off lands for the Grail when your steward sends you an urgent letter. The treasury is empty, your neighbors are at war, and there are monsters everywhere! You need to get back and set things right.
map.[hota] help!.header.name: Help!
map.[hota] help!.header.rumor.0.text: Sandro the Necromancer has mastered the art of masquerade. Quite a few heroes have been in his employ without ever realizing it.
map.[hota] help!.header.rumor.1.text: Jamison the Seer is an authority in all matters of treasure hunting. Over the years he aided many heroes in their search for the Grail.
map.[hota] help!.header.rumor.2.text: If you see a golden hare, leave it be! It brings luck.
map.[hota] help!.header.rumor.3.text: The owls are not what they seem.
map.[hota] help!.header.rumor.4.text: Long ago this land was watched over by four Elemental warriors. If you happen upon their tombs, make sure to pay your respects.
map.[hota] help!.header.rumor.5.text: In the north-east sea, a volcano birthed a new island. Wild Devils dwell there now.
map.[hota] help!.header.rumor.6.text: Vampires hate sunlight. Keep that mind if you're looking for their hiding spots.
map.[hota] help!.heroes.107.biography: Long ago Terek fell victim to one of Sandro's plots, which led to his capture and eventual ransom. Yet to live down the shame, he is all too eager to acquaint Sandro with prison life or, better yet, his blade.
map.[hota] help!.heroes.116.biography: King Tralossk never really liked Alkin, but gave him his own command in the hopes that he would one day get himself killed. That never happened, and Alkin has led a long and glorious career, much to the displeasure of the King.
map.[hota] help!.heroes.117.biography: Years of travel gave Tyrzic a firm grasp on how to make it in the outer wilds. He has since become a guiding star for Tatalian exilants, helping them settle in places Kilgor can't reach.
map.[hota] help!.heroes.128.biography: After the fall of Kreelah most of the Confluxes vanished, and so did their generals. Whether Voleia stayed behind as a safeguard or because she has grown fond of this world is for her to say.
map.[hota] help!.heroes.14.biography: Restoring Temple Stone in Freehaven turned George from a savvy stonecutter into a man of quiet, but rock-solid faith. He came to Erathia to rebuild what the Devils had destroyed, and likewise to rekindle the faith in others.
map.[hota] help!.heroes.140.biography: Among his fellow Elementalists, Creber is the subject of a heated debate over nature versus nurture. He has served the Conflux faithfully, however.
map.[hota] help!.heroes.15.biography: Before she was granted command, Caitlin was considered by some to be possessed by evil spirits. Despite these claims, donations to her church were unsurpassed when she was still in the church's ranks.
map.[hota] help!.heroes.163.biography: Paul spent several years in a troupe of bards before he traded his fiddle for a blade. He now captains the Zephyr, named after a star-nymph whose realm he once toured. His worldly outlook makes him a fine sailor.
map.[hota] help!.heroes.166.biography: Droom was a raider off the coast of Krewlod until Kilgor came to power. When the Barbarian King's new armada sunk his ship, Droom duly went down with it and was presumed dead - until now.
map.[hota] help!.heroes.169.biography: Zilare was a library keeper in Erathia, having dedicated his life to browsing through old archives. However, he couldn't always keep things together in his head. Fired over the supposed theft of a rare book, he became a cook on a pirate ship. Later life led Zilare to developing arcane powers. He learned to control the memory of allies and enemies alike.
map.[hota] help!.heroes.181.biography: Few in Silver Cove knew of John's dark past until a trio of sinister cyborgs came to enlist him in their master's cause, threatening to otherwise burn down the town. Three shots rang out, and John rode off, never to return.
map.[hota] help!.heroes.19.biography: Ryland was the first (and to date, the only) human ever fully accepted by the Circle of Elder Dendroids as a Ranger of AvLee. Some joke that he was once an Elf, but that he was killed and accidentally reincarnated into a human's body.
map.[hota] help!.heroes.192.biography: From Loyt's brilliant mind sprung the blueprints for the Lightning Rod, a miracle weapon that can strike from any distance. In search for a fusion core strong enough to power it, she set her eyes on the Grail.
map.[hota] help!.heroes.211.biography: Madma's inner fire led her tribe through many dark nights of the soul. Over time, however, it grew into a flamestorm. Branded a war hawk and firebrand by the other tribes, she was forced on a mainland sabbatical.
map.[hota] help!.heroes.27.biography: Gem was one of the greatest sorceresses that Enroth had ever seen, serving King Roland Ironfist during the Succession Wars. Shortly after Roland had secured the throne of Enroth, Gem left for Erathia, finding a new home in AvLee.
map.[hota] help!.heroes.31.biography: Ilmo had always longed for the far horizon. When his native AvLee's infighting and power plays hit a boiling point, he had one more reason to follow his heart's desire and chose to finally act on it.
map.[hota] help!.heroes.34.biography: In theory any hard material can be golemized. As legend tells it, the first Golems were even made of clay. Josephine, however, prefers praxis over theory and facts over legend, sticking to cold, hard iron in spite of her colleagues' experiments.
map.[hota] help!.heroes.4.biography: In the wake of Lord Haart's betrayal his younger brother has made the voyage from Enroth to restore the family name. The two's striking resemblance, however, has only sparked rumors of old Haart's return from the dead.
map.[hota] help!.heroes.55.biography: Ringo was a circus ringmaster in eastern Erathia before the Devils invaded. His affinity for whips and chains makes him well-liked among the equally cruel Pit Fiends.
map.[hota] help!.heroes.60.biography: After the war, Redda set out for new shores. Her talent for sniffing out Sulfur deposits made her well-liked in Nighon, but an envious warlock eventually saw to her betrayal and downfall.
map.[hota] help!.heroes.64.biography: Even though he has been a Zombie for years, Straker refuses to fully accept his new nature, insisting on being human still. Those closest to him know this to be a matter of simple vanity: he has always been obsessed with his looks.
map.[hota] help!.heroes.65.biography: Nearly four centuries ago, Vokial ruled his own kingdom, but as time passed he grew increasingly bored with day-to-day responsibilities. He eventually gave up everything to return to the life of adventuring he much preferred. He is an elder even among other Vampires.
map.[hota] help!.heroes.66.biography: Moandor's charismatic style somehow stayed with him after he was transformed into a Lich. Strangely enough, this provides him with the ability to lead and recruit new Liches more effectively than any other hero.
map.[hota] help!.heroes.74.biography: All his life and beyond Sandro has dreamt to rule the world. Chasing this dream, he set his eyes on the Grail, hoping that its untold powers will finally prove his supremacy.
map.[hota] help!.heroes.76.biography: Thant joined Sandro's hunt for the Grail in hopes of using its powers to restore the Nightshade Brazier. However, their alliance quickly fell apart, leaving Thant to languish in prison.
map.[hota] help!.heroes.89.biography: It is strange to see a troglodyte Overlord, and stranger still to see a troglodyte Warlock, yet Jaegar has proven to be a skilled mage. He claims that daily meditation is the secret to his success.
map.[hota] help!.heroes.92.biography: Studies into the Ancients helped Geon greatly refine his telepathic skill. Eyeless yet all-seeing, he is given a wide berth by other Warlocks for fear of having their secrets revealed.
map.[hota] help!.heroes.93.biography: Deemer nearly had to be killed as a young adult, as his magical abilities were so out of control that he was a threat to himself and those around him. He has since learned to control his powers, and is more than a formidable foe in combat.
map.[hota] help!.heroes.94.biography: Sephinroth claims to be the illegitimate child of King Gryphonheart. His refusal to acknowledge her has served to fuel her hatred against the Throne of Erathia, which she one day hopes to claim for herself. Having joined the ranks of the Warlocks, she is the only known woman ever to bear that title.
map.[hota] help!.quest.100.37.1.complete: Seven is the number of spellcraft, magicka and mystic secrets. As such, you are granted a lesson in a school of the arcane.
map.[hota] help!.quest.100.37.1.firstVis: The Seer tells you of the magic of numerals, such as the unitary One, jinxed Thirteen, and Seven, the number of sorcery. Those whose journey has met its seventh stage shall receive a boon reflective of this symbolic power.
map.[hota] help!.quest.100.37.1.nextVisi: The Seer affirms that only those whose journey has met its seventh stage may receive the blessing of the mystic Seven.
map.[hota] help!.quest.104.16.0.complete: As your soldiers tie the thirty Ore to the submarine's hull, you're offered the Seer's pair of enchanted sandals - made for walking, they'll be of little use in the impending voyage.
map.[hota] help!.quest.104.16.0.firstVis: Enticing dreams of a golden octopus in an undersea garden drove the Seer to build a submarine. It's nearly done, but an additional thirty Ore are needed to serve as sinking weights.
map.[hota] help!.quest.104.16.0.nextVisi: Hunched over maps and charts of ocean currents, the Seer asks you to deliver thirty Ore so the undersea voyage can begin.
map.[hota] help!.quest.106.77.0.complete: As foretold, you bring thirty Gems to the nearby coral reef where a giant golden crab emerges to adorn its shell with them. Also lodged in its shell is a great trident which you can try to pull out once the crab draws closer.
map.[hota] help!.quest.106.77.0.firstVis: Reading the future from shellfish innards, the Seer envisions you gathering thirty Gem stones and bringing them to a nearby coral reef, whereupon you will receive a powerful artifact.
map.[hota] help!.quest.106.77.0.nextVisi: Since you do not have the thirty Gem stones needed to fulfil the Seer's mysterious vision, you depart after a brief rest.
map.[hota] help!.quest.15.106.0.complete: You inform the Seer's shade that the Library of Enlightenment is safe again. Relieved, the shade bestows you with a blessing of wisdom before moving on to the afterlife.
map.[hota] help!.quest.15.106.0.firstVis: A ghostly shade hovers above the Seer's slain body. You learn that the attackers, long gone, have moved on to the north-west Library of Enlightenment to further extinguish the realm's bright minds.
map.[hota] help!.quest.15.106.0.nextVisi: Languishing, the Seer's shade implores you to sail to the Library of Enlightenment and drive off its attackers.
map.[hota] help!.quest.2.41.0.completed: Once told of the university’s siege and liberation, the Seer gifts you one of the golden canary’s feathers. It’s bright as flames and likely worth a fortune.
map.[hota] help!.quest.2.41.0.firstVisit: While tending to a sickly golden canary, the Seer tells you that the bird’s soul is linked to the foundation stone of a university the Seer helped build. As such, the canary’s illness may spell a bad omen for the university.
map.[hota] help!.quest.2.41.0.nextVisit: The Seer’s old university lies on a forlorn isle in the far south-west. As the canary is still unwell, there may be trouble brewing there.
map.[hota] help!.quest.27.19.1.completed: With thirty Crystals, the scrying orb can be pieced back together. The Seer offers to then gaze through it into your future, bestowing to you in advance what you'd else learn in the battles to come.
map.[hota] help!.quest.27.19.1.firstVisi: The Seer's scrying orb - a giant, mammoth-sized crystal ball that takes up most of the tiny house - has been shattered by evil raiders. To repair it the Seer requires thirty shards of Crystal.
map.[hota] help!.quest.27.19.1.nextVisit: Tending to the shattered crystal scrying orb, the Seer reminds you that no less than thirty Crystals are required for its restoration.
map.[hota] help!.quest.28.93.0.completed: Equipped with twenty Wood, the Seer plans to depart for the temple's bowels to reinforce its shaken foundation, but before doing so offers you to teach you Lady Sylph's primordial Water Magic.
map.[hota] help!.quest.28.93.0.firstVisi: The Seer tells you that this ruin is what's left of a temple of Lady Sylph, the Warden of Tides, but much of it was swept away in a storm. In order to rebuild it the Seer needs twenty Wood, for which you are promised Lady Sylph's teachings.
map.[hota] help!.quest.28.93.0.nextVisit: You find the Seer in deep prayer to Lady Sylph, the Warden of Tides, and recall the request of twenty Wood to restore the temple proper.
map.[hota] help!.quest.29.57.1.completed: Acting on a hunch, you ask to hold the Seer's tablet yourself, whereupon the cryptic glyphs miraculously change shape into readable words - it's a summoning formula for warriors from the age of the pyramids.
map.[hota] help!.quest.29.57.1.firstVisi: Dreams led the Seer to an old desert tomb holding a golden stone tablet. Though it's difficult to decrypt, the Seer points out that the number Twelve is mentioned throughout.
map.[hota] help!.quest.29.57.1.nextVisit: Studying the mysterious tablet, the Seer wonders what role the frequently-mentioned number Twelve plays in it.
map.[hota] help!.quest.33.50.0.completed: The Seer admits to being Melusine’s last descendant. A drop of the Seer’s blood can purify the cursed shield and reveal the winged serpent’s sigil below.
map.[hota] help!.quest.33.50.0.firstVisi: Drawing from old past, the Seer speaks of Melusine, a winged serpent who protected her kin with her golden shield. This relic was later lost and corrupted, but there is still hope for its restoration.
map.[hota] help!.quest.33.50.0.nextVisit: The golden shield of the winged serpent is now corrupted by evil. If you find it, the Seer may try to restore it.
map.[hota] help!.quest.34.11.1.completed: Convinced that you can put his risen ancestors to rest, the warrior lets you through. However, he declines to join you, as it’s bad luck to fight one‘s own kin.
map.[hota] help!.quest.34.11.1.firstVisi: The garrison is manned by a warrior who wants to contain the necromantic curse which Lord Sandro has cast upon his ancestral crypt. Likewise, he is wary to let anyone in, lest they add to the undeads‘ numbers.
map.[hota] help!.quest.34.11.1.nextVisit: The warrior judges you too inexperienced to face the might of his ancestors.
map.[hota] help!.quest.43.31.0.completed: In return for the two Dragon Flies, the Seer offers you a batch of colorful gemstones that were found at the lake's bottom.
map.[hota] help!.quest.43.31.0.firstVisi: The lake's frogs and water striders have told the Seer that once here also lived Dragon Flies, but overhunting wiped them out. Wishing to restore the lake's fauna in full, the Seer asks for two such creatures.
map.[hota] help!.quest.43.31.0.nextVisit: Hinting at a treasure found in the lake's depths, the Seer suggests you make haste to gather a pair of Dragon Flies.
map.[hota] help!.quest.43.96.1.completed: Beneath the runes and paint, the golden snake’s rattle still holds great power, attracting one of its eldest kin.
map.[hota] help!.quest.43.96.1.firstVisi: The Seer tells you of a golden rattlesnake whose tail, upon its killing, was cut off and runes carved into each segment, thus creating a dark talisman. In the deep abyss, the snake’s kin still mourns for their defiled sister.
map.[hota] help!.quest.43.96.1.nextVisit: The Seer reaffirms the snakes‘ plea for the rattle of their slain sister, which likely fell into the hands of evil shamans or death cults.
map.[hota] help!.quest.46.7.0.completed: Sensing that your mind is strong enough to subdue the Fangarms, the Seer offers to summon twenty such beasts at your command.
map.[hota] help!.quest.46.7.0.firstVisit: The Seer speaks of mermaids whose charm brought down entire kingdoms, and of their Fangarm brothers who did the same by more practical means. Offering to summon the latter, the Seer cautions that only the strongest of minds can resist their magic.
map.[hota] help!.quest.46.7.0.nextVisit: At your current state, the summoned Fangarms would overwhelm your senses. The Seer suggests you continue your arcane training and return at a later time.
map.[hota] help!.quest.56.82.0.completed: The golden dolphin duly patrolled all four corners of the sea. By bestowing you with the talisman, the Seer hopes that you follow in its example.
map.[hota] help!.quest.56.82.0.firstVisi: The Seer reminisces of a golden dolphin who kept watch over the ocean until slain by greedy whalers. A talisman in the dolphin’s image will be granted to those who share the animal’s protective spirit.
map.[hota] help!.quest.56.82.0.nextVisit: Bluntly telling you that you’re not fit to protect, the Seer holds onto the golden dolphin’s talisman for now.
map.[hota] help!.quest.67.15.0.completed: Before leaving for the mountains with the Speculum, the Seer can teach you the secrets of the stars, most of all how to invoke their wrath.
map.[hota] help!.quest.67.15.0.firstVisi: The Seer tells you that the future is written in the stars and thus wishes to study comets and meteors, believing them intrepid rogues of fate. In order to do so, however, the Seer requires a Speculum.
map.[hota] help!.quest.67.15.0.nextVisit: There’s a big difference between simple stargazing and the deep study of stars. For the latter, the Seer is in need of a Speculum.
map.[hota] help!.quest.75.32.0.completed: Not only the Seer, but also the four Forest Guards are grateful for your aid. Once relieved of duty, they will leave to you a quill of their finest arrows.
map.[hota] help!.quest.75.32.0.firstVisi: Foretelling an age of no gods and masters but nature, the Seer wishes to confer with the forest spirits of the deep woods, but requires a squad of the Forest Guard to ensure a safe voyage.
map.[hota] help!.quest.75.32.0.nextVisit: The Seer tells you that an outpost of the Forest Guard lies on a secluded islet in the central sea. A squad of their soldiers can be recruited at a week’s notice.
map.[hota] help!.quest.96.100.1.complete: While not alive, Obsidian Gargoyles are still affected by magic of the mind. A scroll of one such spell is offered to you in trade for the two beasts.
map.[hota] help!.quest.96.100.1.firstVis: The Seer speaks at length of the line between life and undeath. Gargoyles are neither, but rather within a gray zone dubbed Bloodless. To study their state of being, the Seer asks for two Obsidian Gargoyles.
map.[hota] help!.quest.96.100.1.nextVisi: Wizards have made an old chateau in the south-western sea their base of research. The Seer advises you to gather Obsidian Gargoyles there, though they may also be found roaming the wilds.
map.[hota] help!.questEvents.10.questCom: A military exercise near the drawbridge sees it swiftly opened. With you around, the Minotaurs see no reason to guard the warehouse any longer and, thus relieved of duty, ask to serve under you instead.
map.[hota] help!.questEvents.10.questPro: Deeming you unworthy of their attention, the Minotaurs tell you to get lost.
A pair of Minotaurs guards this drawbridge. They were hired by the warehouse owner to fend off raiders, although they admit that they yearn for a job more befitting of their prowess.
map.[hota] help!.questEvents.11.questCom: Hopeful that you'll put their risen ancestors to rest, the Swordsmen lower the drawbridge and, given their personal stakes in this quest, ask to fight by your side.
map.[hota] help!.questEvents.11.questPro: Deeming you unsuited to face their risen ancestors, the four Swordsmen refuse to let you pass.

Four Swordsman brothers hold this garrison. They wish to contain the necromantic curse that befell their family crypt, and likewise are wary to let just about anyone in, lest they end up adding to the Undeads' numbers.
map.[hota] help!.questEvents.12.questCom: Aiming down your iron sights, you strike the steel trap's weak spots and send it crashing down. From the wreckage you retrieve several Automatons which are swiftly reprogrammed, patched up and drafted into your ranks.
map.[hota] help!.questEvents.12.questPro: Without hawk-eyed precision, trying to defuse the trap would go fatally awry.

A spider’s web of wires and steel cables covers the gateway. In the corners you spy spindle-legged Automatons lying in wait for trespassers. Rather than spring this deadly trap, you can defuse it from afar with a well-placed shot.
map.[hota] help!.questEvents.22.questCom: You reason with the Elves to pass the shrine's care - and access - on to you as you're better suited to protect it. Grateful for the relief, the Elves also leave you the payment given to them by the scholars.
map.[hota] help!.questEvents.22.questPro: The Elves fire a warning shot above your head - their way of telling you that you're unworthy of entering.

From atop the tower several Elves train their bows at you. With raiders and thieves running wild, they were paid by the shrine's scholars to only let those pass who come with an open and - more importantly - well-studied mind.
map.[hota] help!.questEvents.25.questCom: Applying your tactical expertise, you beat each of the four Magi in chess through a clever mix of the Queen's Gambit and Wrong-Rook Pawn, whereupon they yield and request to join your ranks.
map.[hota] help!.questEvents.25.questPro: You join the Magi guardians in their games of chess, but quickly find yourself outmatched and beaten. A more tactical mind might prevail here.
With the workshop's subjects running loose, four Magi are guarding the bridge towards it. To kill time, they're playing games of chess and invite you to join.
map.[hota] help!.questEvents.26.questCom: Adept in enduring pain, you make your way through the thorny thicket and in its midst find the artifact whose powers sparked its rapid growth. When you remove it the thicket recedes, clearing the path ahead.
map.[hota] help!.questEvents.26.questPro: Wary of the thorny thicket's dangers, you choose to turn around and perhaps return once you've grown a thicker skin.
A thicket of poisonous thorns looms before you. To proceed, you must have a deep understanding of how to withstand dangers such as this.
map.[hota] help!.questEvents.9.questComp: Drawing from your knowledge of the Vori arcane, you successfully disable the force field and capture the Shaman duo before they can flee. They explain that they only meant to protect the black market, and to make amends offer to join your ranks.
map.[hota] help!.questEvents.9.questProg: You strike at the Shamans' force field, but it's for naught. Only an expert of rune magic can disable it.
map.[hota] help!.questEvents.9.questProp: A luminous force field envelops the black market, maintained by a pair of snow-folk Shamans who refuse to reason with you. In order to disable it you would have to match their deep understanding of rune magic.

North -> Ore Mine
South -> Shipyard
map.[hota] help!.sign.16.36.0.message: One day we'll have our revenge, but first we must tend to our wounded. Chiqtli knows of a cavern of wild verdant growth - almost like home, I reckon.
map.[hota] help!.sign.17.80.1.message:
: Last Light :

North -> Sulfur Dunes
South -> Warren
map.[hota] help!.sign.35.103.0.message:
: New Solitune :

West -> Shipyard
East -> School of Magic
map.[hota] help!.sign.42.40.0.message:
: Southern Compass :

North -> Magic Lantern
South -> Observatory
map.[hota] help!.sign.43.89.0.message: They keep us locked in the tower - luckily, this gold-hawk found its way in to carry forth our cry for help. Look for us in the desert sunrise.
map.[hota] help!.sign.44.75.0.message:
: Far Horizon :

West -> Cloud Temple
East -> Treetop Tower
map.[hota] help!.sign.49.61.1.message:
: Scalen Flume :

West -> Arena
East -> Wyvern Nest
map.[hota] help!.sign.51.8.0.message: Beloved Dy, I hope this letter finds you one day. We shall soon assail Sandro's harbor, but I fear it'll be our end. Hug the youngins for me, dearest.
map.[hota] help!.sign.56.85.1.message:
: Rum Runner Grotto :

West -> Nymph Waterfall
East -> Tree of Knowledge
map.[hota] help!.sign.65.64.0.message: Dream Journal, 5th of Spring: A festive dinner of undead nobility. They raise their glasses to a shield above the hearth. It's blackened, as if burnt.
map.[hota] help!.sign.69.12.1.message:
: Timbre Gulch :

West -> Sawmill
East -> Tree of Knowledge
map.[hota] help!.sign.82.33.0.message:
: Isoldan Weald :

North -> Windmill
South -> Unicorn Glade
map.[hota] help!.sign.83.72.0.message:
: Cape Calx :

West -> Arena
East -> Ivory Tower
map.[hota] help!.sign.89.18.1.message:
: Veins of Fire :

West -> Cannon Yard
East -> Alchemist's Lab
map.[hota] help!.sign.89.5.0.message:
: Vagrant's Crossing :

West -> Shipyard
East -> Troll Bridge
map.[hota] help!.sign.9.74.0.message: Heed my advice, sailor: Beware of the chasm in the heart of the sea. Underwater, treasures abound - but so do its wardens, monsters most foul.
map.[hota] help!.sign.94.39.0.message: We lost Cass and Vera to the Sirens. It pains me, but had we kept west, those Devils would've skewered us all. Where did they come from, I wonder?
map.[hota] help!.sign.96.89.0.message:
: Gold Star Mountains :

North -> Shipyard
South -> Gem Pond

map.[hota] help!.townEvents.16.rewardMes:
You've had run-ins with the warlocks of Undearth in the past; an odd lot, albeit wise in the ways of magic. Over a round of ale you agree to an uneasy but promising alliance.

As a gesture of good faith - what little there is -, the Undearth council dispatches its personal Troglodyte servants to the garrison to be outfitted with spears and trained for battle.
map.[hota] help!.townEvents.17.rewardMes:
You've found Castle Llacielo mostly vacant, save for the Pixies who hold festivals of music every night to lure back their old masters, or perhaps to dance away their sorrows.

When you make plans to rebuild the altars and summoning gates - a more practical approach -, Pixies from far and wide draw to the town in hopes that you succeed.
map.[hota] help!.townEvents.18.rewardMes:
Fort Guthwulf is an enclave of sorts, sheltering all who wish to take no part in Kilgor's conquest. As far as Barbarians go, they're modest and diplomatic which hastens your peace talks.

Still, they're Barbarians, and thus celebrate your joining with a great festival of tourneys, games and wrestling matches. Come morning, the barracks are bustling with hungover, but eager new recruits.
map.[hota] help!.townEvents.19.message.0:
Within castle Nosferatu you find Sandro's former study where he left behind a swath of journals, maps and notes. After securing the Grail, he was going to invade the overworld via the southern sea-gate.

His evil plans are stopped for now, and you don't expect to see him again, but you can't help but wonder whereto he fled - and when and where he'll meet his end, if ever.
map.[hota] help!.townEvents.19.rewardMes:
Late at night a guard on duty spies a golden hare entering a burrow in Nosferatu's castle moat. When he goes to investigate, he discovers a secret cavern vault of coin, trinkets and jewelry.

The Undead tell you that these items had one by one inexplicably vanished from Sandro's chambers over the past weeks, driving him furious. Meanwhile, the golden hare is nowhere to be found.
map.[hota] help!.townEvents.2.rewardMess:
You turn castle Nosferatu upside down in search for Sandro, but in the chaos he appears to have fled. The surviving Undead, hurt by his betrayal, pledge to henceforth fight for you instead.

Although your soldiers grumble over rubbing shoulders with Zombies or worse, they could prove to be vital allies. Most of all the Graveyard is ripe with fresh recruits after today's battle.
map.[hota] help!.townEvents.21.rewardMes:
Fort Blizzra was built by a tribe of Vori exilants. Like you, they sought for the cavernous dark to hide from prying eyes, and thus see in you an unlikely kindred spirit.

Most of all the Kobolds, curious by nature, welcome this joining of ice and fire. They send word to their hunters and trappers in the outer wilds that greater endeavors lie ahead.
map.[hota] help!.townEvents.4.message.0:
The witches of Vu'Du know little of undead plots and grail-hunts. Far off from the overworld, they instead focus on the mysteries of the abyss and the nearby ruins of the pyramid age.

Though they seldom accept strangers such as you, you're not the first. Over the past weeks they've also let in refugees from war-torn Tatalia and Jadame.
map.[hota] help!.townEvents.4.rewardMess:
While the witches keep to their studies, scrying and divination, you find worldlier minds - and battle-tried warriors - in the makeshift refugee camps.

To celebrate your arrival, they hold a festival in the name of the Holy Firefly, lighting a swath of colorful paper lanterns whose glow attracts several wild Serpent Flies like moths to the flame.
map.[hota] help!.townEvents.5.message.0:
From the highest point of castle Quaysar one can see far and wide across the deep blue sea. But the wizards who built these towers had their eyes fixated upwards, to the stars.

Legend says that they searched for an astral gate to the realm of the star-nymphs. The entire keep was designed with this quest in mind and thus functions like a giant observatory.
map.[hota] help!.townEvents.5.rewardMess:
In fact, you've found various rooms where engines, gears and levers are tirelessly maintained by old, but orderly Golem workers. Very little is known about them since they seldom communicate.

A handful, however, went to the factories to patch themselves up and then join the garrison. Perhaps they decided that fighting by your side is also a way to maintain order.
map.[hota] help!.townEvents.6.message.0:
When volcanoes fall dormant, their ash-infused soil gives birth to lush greenery and teeming wild forests. The Elven keep of Eshe was built atop one such slumbering beast.

Below the earth its fires rage on, which at times can be felt in Eshe in form of momentary soft rumblings in the ground. The peasants pay them no mind - like sea-sickness, one gets used to it eventually.
map.[hota] help!.townEvents.6.rewardMess:
The Elven archers have turned it into a challenge of steady aim. Those who can hit their mark during one of Eshe's tremors are regarded as grand champions of their skill.

Still, the true test of one's mettle lies in combat. After word of your quest reaches the outer woodlands, several hawk-eyed Elves are quick to leave their training grounds and enter the draft.
map.[hota] heritage of the ancients.even: It took you a while to set up an outpost so far from your lands. Unfortunately, your actions did not go unnoticed. Soon, the ruler of a neighboring principality, your old enemy, arrived here too. This time, he hired an elementalist, who is equally eager to find out what secrets the tomb holds. However, you did not waste time either, enlisting the support of your old allies, the elves, who have long borne a grudge against your opponent.

It took you a while to set up an outpost so far from your lands. Unfortunately, your actions did not go unnoticed. Soon, the ruler of a neighboring principality, your old enemy, arrived here too. This time, he enlisted the support of the elves, who have long borne a grudge against you for cutting down their forests. It seems that this lord is equally eager to find out what secrets the tomb holds. But you did not waste time either, meeting an experienced elementalist on the way, who offered his services to you. They say these sorcerers are capable of summoning an entire army!

Knowledge, power... What does this tomb have in store? We do not know, but who other than wizards from the University of the Four Elements can possibly unravel its secrets? It has been a long time since we had a chance to study the legacy of such ancient times. 
However, rumor has it that we are not the only ones who have learned of the Tomb's existence. The greedy rulers of neighboring lands woud never miss an opportunity to get their hands on treasures and new magic knowledge. Their troops will probably appear here soon, so we sent gargoyle messengers to them.

It seems that you and your enemy are not the only ones who know about the Tomb. A gargoyle flew into our camp today. Of course, the creature was shot on the spot, but it carried a message in its paws. 
A wizard, who introduced himself as a representative of some University, reported that he and his “colleagues” knew about both the Tomb and your plans. He warned about the dangers allegedly lurking in the Tomb and hinted that you had no business being there. 
Without saying a word, you tear up the letter and return to your men to give new orders.

The gargoyles we sent with messages never returned, so we assume the worst; the rulers must have decided not only to settle their old scores, but also dared challenge us, ignoring our warning. So much the worse for them.
map.[hota] heritage of the ancients.head: An ancient tomb was found in faraway lands. Who knows what treasures and knowledge it holds? Alas, to your great dismay, your enemy has already learned about your plans to explore it…
Heritage of the Ancients
The Tomb is guarded by genies and efreet. Don’t mess with them!
Last time I was in the Tomb, I couldn't get out the same way I got in.
Don’t listen to what people say! It’s pretty easy to get out of the Tomb!
Once, travelling to the Tomb, I ran into a weird hovering eye. I barely escaped with my life!
They say that basilisks moved to the Tomb through the portals and settled there.
map.[hota] heritage of the ancients.ques: Do you want to conduct the ritual and create a portal to the Plane of Water?

There is a nexus of magic energy here; you could use it to create a portal to the Plane of Water and summon water elementals. However, you’ll have to pay 6000 gold for the ingredients needed for the ritual.
You can’t afford the ritual yet.

Great, here it is.
Do you want to buy the magic armor from the merchant?

I’m but a lowly merchant, but not so long ago I came by a thing of great magic power. The vagabond who brought it to me said he had found it in the Tomb and had barely escaped with it, being chased by some odd monsters. I don't know if this is true, but the item is of no use to me. I would be happy to offer it to you for mere 15 gems.
No, I wouldn’t sell this for less than 15 gems. In different conditions, it could command a much higher price.
Do you want to hire the Pixies?
You can hire Pixies here, but they demand 3500 gold.
The Pixies are not ready to join your ranks for less than 3500 gold.
Do you want to hire the Magi?
Magi mercenaries take stand here. To hire them for your army, you’ll have to pay them 5000 gold.
The Magi are not ready to join your ranks for less than 5000 gold.

Do you want to take the magic scroll from a druid?

I arrived here as a representative of the Circle of Druids. I want to study the creatures who settled down in the Tomb; who knows how a habitat like this influenced them? Bring me enough creatures so I could do research, and I will give you a magic scroll that would allow you to travel over water as easily as over land.
No, I need more creatures for my research. Return when you have enough of them.
Do you want to hire the Elves and get the anti-magic armor?
Elf mercenaries take stand here. To hire them for your host, you’ll have to pay them 5000 gold. They also have a decent armor enchanted to repel magic.
The Elves are not ready to join your ranks for less than 5000 gold.

map.[hota] ice assault.event.2.descripti:
In recent years, it's been getting colder and colder, and grazing grounds are becoming increasingly scarce. The elders are gathering to discuss an attack on our enemies' lands.
However, rumors have reached us: portals have opened near our villages. Apparently, our enemies have learned of our plans and are preparing to attack us. We must prepare for any eventuality.
map.[hota] ice assault.event.3.descripti: It is said that the lizardmen and gnolls of the eastern islands have entered into the service of demons. It is difficult to say what prompted these creatures to take such a step, but it is known that a volcano has awakened on the northeastern islands. Hordes of Gogs surrounded by Cerberi and other creatures have been seen near it.
map.[hota] ice assault.event.4.descripti: A kobold, sent to explore one of the distant portals, brought odd news. The elven sorceress who rules the northern islands has opened portals to a distant, uncharted land she calls the "world of chaos." We don't know what might await us on the other side of these portals, but it seems the elves themselves are showing great interest in them.
map.[hota] ice assault.event.5.descripti: The yeti report disturbing news. They managed to penetrate the "world of chaos" following the elf who opened a portal there. It turns out the portal leads to lands ruled by the forces of cold and death. They are gathering troops to invade our lands, and they are led by a dark sorceress who has subjugated the will of the elves. Her forces are vast, and their ranks include not only the undead, but even titans and powerful blue dragons. And it seems she is behind the quarrels among all the neighbors.
map.[hota] ice assault.header.descriptio: For centuries, the inhabitants of the icy land have stayed within their lands, fighting off raids from their neighbors drawn by the crystals and other riches. In recent months, however, the weather has grown colder, and now our enemies' realms are suffering from frost. It's time to strike back.

map.[hota] ice assault.quest.101.88.0.co: Would you like to give the witch gold and resources in exchange for the gorgons?
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.101.88.0.fi: The witch tells you that after everything she's been through lately, she no longer cares about power. However, she wants to save enough money to retire and live a comfortable life. She believes 20,000 gold, 30 measures of sulfur, and the same amount of mercury will be enough. In exchange, she will give you her last herd of gorgons.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.101.88.0.ne: The witch does not agree to a smaller amount, and you do not have the necessary funds at the moment.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.102.103.1.c: The shaman begins a strange ritual, but it fails: both he and the birds vanish in a burst of flame. Well, at least the tame blue dragon is still here. Would you like to take it with you?
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.102.103.1.f: The old shaman says he wants to create an endless source of heat, but to do so, he needs five live firebirds. In exchange, he'll give you a blue dragon he managed to tame.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.102.103.1.n: Without birds, a shaman cannot create a source of fire.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.104.97.0.co: The farm guards have scattered. Do you want to go through?
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.104.97.0.fi: Here, Thias breeds gorgons. To take possession of the farm, its current owner must be eliminated. They say he keeps some kind of magical trinket there.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.104.97.0.ne: As long as Thias is alive, the farm belongs to him.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.105.6.0.com: Viveca is defeated, and the barrier is now easily removed. Do you wish to proceed?
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.105.6.0.fir: The passage is closed by a magical barrier, maintained by an elven sorceress, protecting her current mistress.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.105.6.0.nex: First defeat the elven sorceress, then you can pass.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.106.58.1.co: Do you want to attract dragons to your service?
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.106.58.1.fi: Azure dragons live here and are willing to serve you for a reasonable fee. 75,000 gold, 50 mercury and 50 gems will do.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.106.58.1.ne: Azure dragons will not settle for less than 75,000 gold, 50 mercury and 50 gems.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.11.94.0.com: The guards have scattered, and the gates are now open. Do you want to go through?
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.11.94.0.fir: This road leads to a portal that the local knights call "the gates of heaven" and guard like nothing else. As long as the head of their order, Rhiannon, lives, it will be impossible to pass through.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.11.94.0.nex: Rhiannon is alive, and the guards at the gates will not let you pass, and you will not be able to take it by storm.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.14.32.0.com: The barbarian is ready to gift you his club. Would you like to take it?
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.14.32.0.fir: An old barbarian lives in this house. He's willing to gift his favorite club to anyone who can demonstrate sufficient attack skill.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.14.32.0.nex: Your skills are not yet sufficient, come back later.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.2.92.0.comp: Do you want to learn a powerful resurrection spell?
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.2.92.0.firs: Priests who know the secret of resurrecting the dead live here. They are willing to share it with you, but in exchange, they require you to bring them the Cornucopia, so that they may have everything they need for the rest of their days. They are also willing to give you one of three keys needed to enter the magical library in the northern caves. The components of the Cornucopia can be found in the treasuries of the blue dragons: two on the islands to the north, one in the sea to the south, and one somewhere in the caves.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.22.11.1.com: With the key you found on Waneda, you can open the treasury. Do you wish to enter?
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.22.11.1.fir: This is the treasury of Waneda. They say it holds magic armor and a key to the devils’ town east from here..
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.22.11.1.nex: Waneda still has the key to the treasury. You can’t pass here.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.23.1.1.comp: The barrier dissolves. Do you want to pass?
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.23.1.1.firs: Mighty ice sorceress Oona keeps here the key to the gates leading to the elves' town. To remove a magical barrier,you must defeat her.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.23.1.1.next: To pass, you must defeat Oona.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.24.52.0.com: You insert the amulet into a special slot, and the door opens. The elves are ready to join you. Would you like to accept them into your army?
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.24.52.0.fir: Elves languish here, trapped by demons for refusing to fight by their side. They will gladly follow you if you find the key to their prison, in the form of a strange skull amulet. It is said the demons buried it somewhere in the east of these lands.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.24.52.0.nex: Without the key the elves cannot be freed.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.25.96.0.com: Angels are ready to follow you. Do you want to hire them?
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.25.96.0.fir: The angels here have already sworn allegiance to the northern elves, but for the right reward, they're willing to follow you. For their services, they ask for 75 gems and 50,000 gold.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.25.96.0.nex: You don't have the required amount, and the angels won't settle for less.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.27.83.0.fir: This passage leads to the lands of the knights. But first, the barbarian leader, Nell, must be defeated. It would be unwise to leave such a dangerous enemy behind.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.27.83.0.nex: Nell is still alive, and her army is still strong and threatening your rear area.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.35.42.0.com: Do you want to rebuild elf houses?
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.35.42.0.fir: The elven houses have been damaged by fire and the elves are asking you to rebuild their homes. Then they will serve you. You need 40 measures of wood and 25,000 gold.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.35.42.0.nex: More resources are needed to rebuild elven houses.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.36.67.0.fir: The gates here open with a password known only to representatives of the land of ice. Here, the local elders explain how to open the magical barriers with which they have sealed all key points in this area to protect their people from enemy attacks.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.36.67.0.nex: The gates here open with a password known only to representatives of the land of ice. Here, the local elders explain how to open the magical barriers with which they have sealed all key points in this area to protect their people from enemy attacks.

map.[hota] ice assault.quest.37.73.0.1.n: The enemy commander is still alive. Kill him and return for your reward.

map.[hota] ice assault.quest.37.73.0.fir: Our elders are willing to pay for the heads of the commanders leading the enemy armies that invade our lands. Bring evidence of the death of Darla, and you will receive the money.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.37.73.0.nex: The enemy commander is still alive. Kill him and return for your reward.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.4.52.0.comp: Sveva is dead, and the jotunns are ready to join your forces. Do you wish to accept them?
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.4.52.0.firs: These jotunns are forced to pay tribute to the witch Sveva, who has settled on an island further south. If you defeat her, they are ready to join you.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.4.52.0.next: Sveva is still strong, the jotunns cannot join you.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.40.46.0.com: The kobolds will easily clear the rockfall, but in exchange, they demand to be released from further service in your army. Are you prepared to make such a deal?
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.40.46.0.fir: There's no way forward—there's a rockfall ahead. The only good thing about it seems to be the remains of a gold vein. It would take 150 skilled miners to clear it all.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.40.46.0.nex: Until you gather sufficient company, you won’t be able to get through here.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.40.50.0.com: The competition organizers are pleased and ready to hand you the arrows. Would you like to take them?
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.40.50.0.fir: An archery competition is being held here. But representatives of the northern elves, underground dwellers, and lizardmen from the eastern lands have not shown up. Find those who agree to participate, and the organizers are willing to give you magic arrows as a reward.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.40.50.0.nex: More participants are needed for the competition to start.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.42.2.1.comp: The librarians look at you, then at the artifacts you've brought, and finally nod. Would you like to enter the library?
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.42.2.1.firs: The librarians in blue robes look at you sternly. They say that only those who take all the signs from their brothers on the surface will be allowed into the library.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.42.2.1.next: Librarians won't let you in without the right signs.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.43.48.0.com: Do you want to build mammoth stalls?
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.43.48.0.fir: Wild mammoths roam here. You can tame them and build stalls for them, but this will cost 15,000 gold and 40 units of ore.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.43.48.0.nex: These funds are not enough to build mammoth stalls.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.45.95.0.fir: This passage leads to the lands of the knights. But first, the barbarian leader, Nell, must be defeated. It would be unwise to leave such a dangerous enemy behind.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.45.95.0.nex: Nell is still alive, and her army is still strong and threatening your rear area.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.49.39.0.com: Neia easily beats the sharpshooters. They are amazed by her skill and ready to join her. Do you want to welcome sharpshooters to your army?
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.49.39.0.fir: The local sharpshooters are eager to embark on adventures with a worthy hero. But they'll only consider someone as worthy as they are at shooting.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.49.39.0.nex: You're losing the competition with sharpshooters. Apparently, someone more skilled is needed.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.49.50.0.com: Are you ready to perform the ritual?
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.49.50.0.fir: This mage has learned to draw power from ice creatures. He agrees to perform a ritual and share some of the resulting power with you if you bring enough of such creatures.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.49.50.0.nex: Until you have brought enough creatures, the ritual cannot be performed.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.5.36.0.comp: The cyclopes are ready to follow you. Do you want to hire them?
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.5.36.0.firs: The local cyclopes want more money and crystals for their services, which for some reason they value highly. 20 crystals and 10,000 gold are enough to hire them.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.5.36.0.next: You don't have the required amount, and the cyclopes won't agree to less.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.50.106.0.co: The cyclopes are ready to follow you. Do you want to hire them?
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.50.106.0.fi: The local cyclopes want more money and crystals for their services, which for some reason they value highly. 20 crystals and 10,000 gold are enough to hire them.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.50.106.0.ne: You don't have the required amount, and the cyclopes won't agree to less.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.6.44.0.comp: The jotunn emerges from his hut and waves his hand in greeting, inviting you into his abode. Would you like to follow him?
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.6.44.0.firs: A hermit jotunn lives here. He wants to see one of his brothers from the island to the south. Until he hears from them, he won't communicate with you.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.6.44.0.next: The jotunn looks at you and goes back into the hut.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.68.7.0.comp: Ossian is dead, and the barrier can now be easily removed. Do you wish to proceed further?
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.68.7.0.firs: The passage is blocked by a magical barrier brimming with necrotic energy. This is clearly Ossian's doing.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.68.7.0.next: As long as Ossian is alive, it is useless to try to pass.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.68.84.0.com: Would you like these Shamans to join you?
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.68.84.0.fir: These Shamans are terrified by what's been happening in the world lately. They trust only their own kind and won't join anyone else. They say they possess some kind of a magical artifact.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.68.84.0.nex: Until one of them is with you, the Shamans don't even want to listen to you.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.72.103.0.co: You insert the key you took from Nell into the lock and the gate opens. Would you like to pass?
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.72.103.0.fi: This passage leads to the Silver Caves. The key to it has recently been kept by Nell, and now the neighbor clearly won't give it up to you.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.72.103.0.ne: This passage leads to the Silver Caves. The key to it has recently been kept by Nell, and now the neighbor clearly won't give it up to you.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.74.8.0.firs: Austain the Elementalist have created the water barrier blocking any passage in these waters. Until he is defeated, the barrier will stand.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.74.8.0.next: Austain the Elementalist have created the water barrier blocking any passage in these waters. Until he is defeated, the barrier will stand.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.75.47.0.com: Do you wish to give the Pendant of Reflection to the sorcerer?
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.75.47.0.fir: The local sorcerer is willing to teach you how to blind your opponents in battle. In exchange, he wants the Pendant of Reflection worn by Porphyrios.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.75.47.0.nex: The sorcerer only needs the Pendant, he will not agree to anything else.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.76.106.0.co: Now the mage can found his own order, and he offers you a magic book. Will you take it?
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.76.106.0.fi: You enter the home of a hermit mage who has lived in these parts for a long time. He says he wants to found an order of magical mastery, and to do so, he needs fifty worthy apprentices. In exchange, he's willing to give you a powerful magical book. They say the best mages live in the north, in the lands of the elves who study elemental magic.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.76.106.0.ne: You haven't yet gathered the required number of apprentices, and without them it's better not to bother the mage.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.78.27.1.com: Do you want to attract angels to your service?
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.78.27.1.fir: Angels live here and are willing to serve you for a reasonable fee. 50,000 gold and 50 gems will do.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.78.27.1.nex: Angels will not settle for less than 50,000 gold and 50 gems.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.80.34.0.com: Do you wish to get the magical helm?
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.80.34.0.fir: A powerful retired water mage lives here. He wants you to bring him several valuable composite artifacts for study—the components of these relics are scattered throughout these lands, and traveling on his own is becoming too difficult for him. In exchange, he promises to give you his magical helm — the mage can hardly use it for anything except brewing tea now, anyway.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.9.44.0.comp: The jotunn is ready to begin his tale right now. Would you like to hear his instructions?
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.9.44.0.firs: The jotunn explains to you that he needs eight pendants he once acquired during glorious campaigns, but then sold them to various people, and he doesn't know where they are now. If you bring them, he's ready to share his wisdom with you.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.9.44.0.next: The jotunn looks at you, not saying a word. He clearly has no intention of speaking to you until you bring him the pendants.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.91.11.1.com: The devils are opening the passage to their home. Do you want to go through?
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.91.11.1.fir: The local devils avoid Harro like the plague. As long as he's alive, they won't accept your command.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.91.11.1.nex: Harro is still alive, and the devils don't want to come into your service.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.91.94.1.com: Harro is vanquished, and you can pass.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.91.94.1.fir: Harro the Efreeti have created the barrier, blocking the passage here. You need to defeat him if you want to pass.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.91.94.1.nex: Harro the Efreeti have created the barrier, blocking the passage here. You need to defeat him if you want to pass.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.92.107.0.co: You insert the intricate key into a keyhole on one of the columns, and the portal glows with a soft light. Do you wish to enter?
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.92.107.0.fi: One of the captured lizardmen said he saw the demon lord Harro give the key to this portal to the lizardman chieftain Thias. He most likely still has it.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.92.107.0.ne: Without defeating Thias, the key to the mysterious portal cannot be obtained.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.95.93.1.com: The barrier dissolves. Behind it you can absorb a part of power of Ossmee and find a key to a magical spring. Do you want to pass?
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.95.93.1.fir: This is the residence of Ossmee. Here is where her tent is put up. It is closed with a magical barrier, without defeating its owner, you can’t pass.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.95.93.1.nex: To pass, you must defeat Ossmee.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.96.24.1.com: The demons greedily snatch up the gems and scatter. Do you want to pass?
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.96.24.1.fir: The demon guards here can be bribed for 50 gems.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.96.24.1.nex: The demons will not agree to less than 50 gems.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.97.28.1.com: The demons greedily snatch up the gems and scatter. Do you want to pass?

map.[hota] ice assault.quest.97.28.1.nex: The demons will not agree to less than 50 gems.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.98.54.1.com: Porphyrios is gone. Do you want to take the Orb?
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.98.54.1.fir: The Orb of Vulnerability is guarded by a magic barrier. They say that this orb might belong to Porphyrios, the ranger.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.98.54.1.nex: The Orb of Vulnerability is guarded by a magic barrier. They say that this orb might belong to Porphyrios, the ranger.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.99.3.0.comp: Viveca is defeated, and the barrier is now easily removed. Do you wish to proceed?
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.99.3.0.firs: The passage is closed by a magical barrier, maintained by an elven sorceress, protecting her current mistress.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.99.3.0.next: First defeat the elven sorceress, then you can pass.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.99.88.0.com: —  Finally this bastard is dead! — says the witch with obvious satisfaction. — Now, if you want, we can talk.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.99.88.0.fir: A witch who ruled over the lizardmen and gnolls before the demon-worshipper Thias rose to power, lives here. She knows Thias is desperate to kill her, so she won't let anyone past the magical barrier in front of her dwelling as long as he's alive.
map.[hota] ice assault.quest.99.88.0.nex: — Bring me Thias's head, then we'll talk! —  the witch shouts from her dwelling..

You don't have the artifacts the shaman needs.
