Southwest: Lizardmen and Gnolls
Southwest: Caves and Wyvern lair
map.[hota] ice assault.sign.57.77.0.mess: Beware if you're not a local.
map.[hota] ice assault.townEvents.0.mess: After a brief skirmish, we managed to convince the village elder on the northwestern islands to join our expedition.
map.[hota] in defense.event.1.descriptio: A group of fishermen have come from Galantier. They ran like hell itself was on their heels to deliver troubling news: they spied a group of pirates burning fires on a nearby island. This is bad. Looks like the scoundrels are planning to attack us. The biggest problem is, Erathian army's on a march far away, having spared only a couple of guards to protect us. Tough luck for anyone who settled down here. Anyway, we cannot possibly run and the army will take too long to get here. So it seems we've no other option than to stand our ground against the uninvited guests.
map.[hota] in defense.event.2.descriptio: We must take control over Fort Bullden. It won't take much material to rebuild it, but, according to locals, it's currently occupied by a band of brigands. We should deal with those and start preparing to face the pirates there, although it would be even better to attack first.
map.[hota] in defense.event.3.descriptio: The remaining settlements, namely Dulvein and Galantier, are still not aware of the pirate presence. We should get there, gather the militia and prepare for the worst. It would be very useful to erect walls and battlements there, but we'll need scores of wood and ore for that. We have to act, and quickly!
map.[hota] in defense.guards.17.37.0.mes: A horde of creatures with fish-like tails and icy skin are gathered around some sort of an orb. If you wish you may fight them for it.
map.[hota] in defense.guards.32.39.1.mes: You observe a small vault, looking like an open temple with the legendary Golden Bow floating inside it. It is however guarded by Dread Knights. Do you wish to fight for that magnificent artifact?
map.[hota] in defense.header.description: Local villages have caught wind of a menace coming from the sea. Pirates are on their way to pillage these lands. The Erathian army is far away, and the villagers are on their own here…
map.[hota] in defense.header.name: In Defence
map.[hota] in defense.quest.12.58.0.comp: Oh, I've almost lost hope of ever seeing my treasure again! As we agreed, 25 of my students are ready to come under your banner. I assure you, they'll prove to be much more useful than this ring.
map.[hota] in defense.quest.12.58.0.firs: I have heard about your trouble. It turns out I've got some as well. My Ring of Infinite Gems was stolen by thieves and sold for quite a price to the titans on the shore. I understand that you have the pirate menace on your hands, but I can offer you a decent price for the ring. I train enchanters here, and 25 of my students would be eager to come to your aid.
map.[hota] in defense.quest.12.58.0.next: A deal is a deal. No Ring of Infinite Gems means no army of Enchanters for you.
map.[hota] in defense.quest.45.39.1.comp: Oh my! You really went and granted my request! I cannot express my joy with words! Now my experiment may continue without a hitch. I won't even regret parting with a relic for that. This sword has been collecting dust inside my chest for too long already. It is yours.
map.[hota] in defense.quest.45.39.1.firs: Greetings, stranger! Do you suppose you could help me? I'm conducting a very important experiment, but a small nuance escaped me: I need 60 sulphur to complete it, and I currently have none. I'll lose all progress I made if I don't get it, and soon! Could you provide me with the material? I assure you, it will not go unrewarded. I don't have enough money to pay for that, but I've got an item that might be of some use for you.
map.[hota] in defense.quest.57.42.0.comp: I can't believe you did it! Although I don't have to since you brought the heads of these beasts. Well, a deal's a deal, i guess? Make yourself comfortable, and I'll tell you all you need to know.
map.[hota] in defense.quest.57.42.0.firs: A pack of Green Dragons have settled nearby. They are a great danger to everyone, not only a knight travelling on his own. I can't really pay you anything, but I can share my experience. It should come in handy in your war with pirates.
map.[hota] in defense.quest.57.42.0.next: The Green Dragons are still there.

map.[hota] invasion.event.1.description:
The North is harsh and inhospitable. Anyone who has ever dared to set foot on our lands knows this.

For many years, hardly anyone so much as dared to set foot on our frozen soil. Only occasionally, the rulers of neighboring lands, irked with the attacks of yeti and frost giants on their pastures, would launch punitive expeditions here, but those were short-lived; they understood they would be unable to consolidate their hold, let alone capture all of the northern wastelands.

But recently, a messenger from a southern village on the other side of the Rannock river brought alarming news: a huge army of the undead had attacked one of the northern kingdoms, quickly subjugating it.

Before we could do anything, a southern village fell to the undead, and soon they crossed the river and captured another one to the east.

This must stop. If the undead manage to gain a foothold on this shore, dislodging them may prove impossible. We must retake the village and strike back.
map.[hota] invasion.event.2.description: A frost giant who returned from the south says he saw burning boats filled with undead, set ablaze by the elves' arrows. Interesting. It seems as though we're not the only ones fighting these creatures.
map.[hota] invasion.event.3.description: A messenger representing the elves of the southern lands arrived in our village. He reported a large camp of elven archers located in the south, which had been successfully repelling attacks by the undead for some time.
map.[hota] invasion.header.description: For many years, no one dared to invade the northern lands, inhabited only by snow elves and other tribes, and of little value. But the necromancers weren't interested in gold or gems...
map.[hota] invasion.header.name: Invasion
map.[hota] invasion.heroes.64.name: Nepenthes
map.[hota] invasion.quest.1.62.0.complet: Excellent. Are you ready to begin crafting the artifact?
map.[hota] invasion.quest.1.62.0.firstVi: You've met an elven craftsman who makes custom artifacts. He's willing to craft a Golden Bow for 20,000 gold, but it will take some time.
map.[hota] invasion.quest.1.62.0.nextVis: That's not enough! I need 20,000 gold, no less!
map.[hota] invasion.quest.28.47.0.comple: Upon learning of your victory, the jotunn readily announces that he will train your own jotunns for free.
map.[hota] invasion.quest.28.47.0.firstV: The jotunn living on this island complains about his sworn enemies, the minotaurs, who have captured a neighboring island and keep pestering him with uninvited visits. The giant declares he is willing to help you train your own jotunns if you take care of these horned beasts.
map.[hota] invasion.quest.28.47.0.nextVi: The jotunn claims he still hears the roars of minotaurs at night and refuses to help you.
map.[hota] invasion.questEvents.0.messag: Now your Jotunns have become Jotunn Warlords.
Unfortunately, you don't have Jotunns eligible for training.
map.[hota] invasion.questEvents.1.questC: Would you like to exchange the Talisman of Mana and gold for the Ring of Oblivion?
map.[hota] invasion.questEvents.1.questH: Bring 20000 Gold and Talisman of Mana
map.[hota] invasion.questEvents.1.questP: The Elemental is unwavering. He wants 20,000 gold and the Mana Talisman, and nothing else!

In the hut, you're surprised to encounter a magical elemental. It seems the undead have passed it by.
The creature says it's willing to craft an artifact that prevents the resurrection of the undead for 20,000 gold. It also requires the Talisman of Mana to create the artifact, and the elemental mentions in passing that it heard such an artifact has been seen at a Black Market on one of the islands.

You can't understand what the elemental needs gold for, let alone so much of it, but the creature stands its ground.
map.[hota] invasion.questEvents.2.messag: An old shaman lets you know that his village in the northwest has been occupied by hordes of vile undead led by a certain Nepenthes. The shaman says his tribe is ready to help you if you rid the world of this monster.
The shaman is deep in thought. It's best not to disturb him needlessly as long as Nepenthes is still alive (as far as that word applies to the undead).
map.[hota] invasion.questEvents.2.questi:
The shaman is very grateful and informs you that some of his tribesmen are willing to join your ranks, but warns that he can send either his tribe's warriors or his apprentices with you, not both.

Would you like to take Steel Elves or Great Shamans?
map.[hota] invasion.questEvents.3.messag: So be it. Come back next week and your bow will be ready!
Your order hasn't been fulfilled yet. Come back next week.
map.[hota] invasion.questEvents.3.questH: Wait until the beginning of the next week to get the artifact
map.[hota] invasion.questEvents.3.reward: Here is your Golden Bow, as we agreed.
map.[hota] invasion.questEvents.4.messag: "I don't compete with beggars!" the elf cackles, reaching for the bottle.

You miss your target several times in a row, while the sailor hits all three.
"You're just not a good shot, my friend!" the elf chuckles, taking his gold. "Come back when you're a truly skilled marksman."
map.[hota] invasion.questEvents.4.questi: A seafaring elf, a seasoned sea dog, offers to practice archery with you. Would you like to challenge him? The bid is 50 gold.
map.[hota] invasion.questEvents.4.reward:
You hit the target several times in a row, while the sailor misses a couple. He hands you the gold.
"Well!" he declares, "It's been a long, long time since I've run across such a sure shot. Take this Necklace. I've grown too old to sail, but you'll find it useful."
map.[hota] island of dust.event.0.descri: This is the legendary Island of Dust, home for many generations of dragons. You're standing on the shore admiring the newly built fort, which will serve as the base for your glorious deeds.
map.[hota] island of dust.event.1.descri: They'll have to be quite glorious indeed. To breach the dragons' lair, to claim the treasure of five continents all for yourself, and to seethe your blade in the boiling blood! There is a problem, though: your crew spotted three other sheeps sailing towards the isle. Whoever arrived on those, must be planning on doing the same.
map.[hota] island of dust.event.2.descri: Was it a bad idea to rush into the desert right away after disembarking? The coast is still covered in thick growth, despite the burnt middle. These strips of tropical forest are inhabited by scary beasts. It might sound weird, but the beasts seem willing to help you overthrow the dragons.
map.[hota] island of dust.event.3.descri:
The scouts have returned from the Desert. Not all of them. Actually, those who did, barely did it, and they won't be able to go back anytime soon. It would be one thing if they came back covered in burns and torn up by dragon claws... but they brought back worse news! The desert is thick already with spies sent by the three lords whose ships you spied earlier.  
The dragons seem to have lost their grip, and new fortifications have risen above the sands. Looks like the bounty hunters are going to be hunting each other...
map.[hota] island of dust.header.descrip: This tropical isle has been lying in ashes for ages, since its dragon inhabitants scorched the lush land around the crater in the middle. Several adventurers arrived to the once beautiful land. They will have to be fearless and valiant if they want to claim the treasure of the blistering sands.
map.[hota] island of dust.header.name: Island of Dust
map.[hota] island of dust.quest.104.65.0: Finally, some subjects for my experiments! I swear now, by the time there's one last Satyr left I'll iron every error out, and then I'll make as many as I promised!

I'm trying to master the Clone spell, but I don't have enough volunteers I can test it on. Would you be so kind to bring me, say, 24 of the Satyrs whose dwelling is to the North, I'd happily double that number!
Yesterday I experimented with a pig that happened to pass by. It now has two heads anf five legs! Obviously, I'll do much better after you bring me 24 Satyrs!
map.[hota] island of dust.quest.28.9.0.c: Finally, some subjects for my experiments! I swear now, by the time there's one last Boar left I'll iron every error out, and then I'll make as many as I promised!
map.[hota] island of dust.quest.28.9.0.f: I'm trying to master the Clone spell, but I don't have enough volunteers I can test it on. Would you be so kind to bring me, say, 48 of the Boar Riders whose dwelling is to the North, I'd happily double that number!
map.[hota] island of dust.quest.28.9.0.n: Yesterday I tried to clone some pebbles I found on the beach... let's say it wasn't a successful experiment. Obviously, I'll do much better after you bring me 48 Boar Riders!
Finally, some subjects for my experiments! I swear now, by the time there's one last Rogue left I'll iron every error out, and then I'll make as many as I promised!

I'm trying to master the Clone spell, but I don't have enough volunteers I can test it on. Would you be so kind to bring me, say, 48 of the Rogues whose dwelling is to the West, I'd happily double that number!

I took a boat yesterday and went to try my spell on that mermaid there. The result... well, I still can't quite double a living creature, but I think sailors will be happy with what I've accomplished this time. Obviously, I'll do much better after you bring me 48 rogues!
map.[hota] island of dust.quest.8.87.0.c: Finally, some subjects for my experiments! I swear now, by the time there's one last Troll left I'll iron every error out, and then I'll make as many as I promised!
map.[hota] island of dust.quest.8.87.0.f: I'm trying to master the Clone spell, but I don't have enough volunteers I can test it on. Would you be so kind to bring me, say, 18 of the Trolls whose dwelling is to the North, I'd happily double that number!
map.[hota] island of dust.quest.8.87.0.n: Yesterday I was passing by a mill and I decided to experiment with the miller's cockerel. I now have enough chicken heads to make soup for the next month! Obviously, I'll do much better after you bring me 18 trolls!
map.[hota] island of dust.sign.26.82.0.m: Not so fast, o traveler! It may be your last drink before you head into the Waste.
map.[hota] island of dust.sign.34.28.0.m: Not so fast, o traveler! It may be your last drink before you head into the Waste.

map.[hota] just win, or else.event.0.des: Onwards, to battle! There is nothing to wait for: everything is here for your victory! Just come and take it by force... or else.
map.[hota] just win, or else.header.desc: All the fortresses have already been built up, all the mercenaries lured in with coin, and legendary treasures found. All that remains to do is rear up powerful heroes who will seize the opportunity and defeat the adversary, just as well-prepared though.
map.[hota] just win, or else.header.name: Just Win, Or Else
map.[hota] key to victory - the second k: Your enemy runs! Your enemy is terrified! Amid this chaos, your court's loyal sages managed to erect barriers along the entire contact line, encircling the remnants of the enemy host. Nowhere to run, nowhere to hide.
Muster a powerful army and decide for yourself when to pass through the barriers for the final battle. Stand to horse!

Your scouts report: some crucial mines with valuable resources are still held by the enemy. The scoundrel used summoning magic; the mines are now guarded by elementals. Still, you are going to need resources, and you can scarce allow the enemy's heroes, even summoned ones, to nose around your rear! While the risk of sabotage has been mitigated by the newly erected barriers, to defeat the elemental heroes remains your task to tackle.

Your sentries have brought unexpected news. Anticipating his imminent downfall, your enemy has built his own barriers; only his own troops can pass through them. It seems as though you are now to find a new key to victory.
Under the withered roots of a dead tree, you find the Sandals of the Saint.
All the stolen wealth lies behind the magic portal. Even after losing several battles in a row, your enemy is still eager to fight for this treasure.

In the backyard of an Alchemist's Lab, you notice the Armor of Wonder. After a brief chat with the lab's bewildered owner, puzzled as to how the enchanted breastplate wound up on his property, you take it.

Barriers protect these parts from the enemy. His troops will not be able to set foot on this sacred land! If you want to venture beyond the barriers yourself, however, you will have to find the Light Blue Keymaster's Tent first.
The Oracle is ready to show you some interesting places nearby. He bows and waves you into the hut.

You're strolling along the forest's edge, pretending to hunt for mushrooms, but the leprechaun seems to have caught on to your presence. He narrows his eyes, and his dance becomes slower: he is prepared to pounce at you at any moment. As luck would have it, the telltale glint reveals the location of the leprechaun's treasure. Before the green prankster can reach you, you snatch a Celestial Necklace of Bliss out of a small stash.

The tall grass around the old cart hints at its long disuse. You carefully examine the cart: it misses one wheel, and a metal object props up its front axle. It is not without effort that you extract it: to your infinite surprise, it turns out to be the Lion's Shield of Courage.
You feel around the bottom of a fetid puddle and find a hilt. Grabbing it, you pull out the Sword of Judgement, untouched by either rust or reeking scum.
There's an ambush ahead! Luckily, your scouts noticed the Sharpshooters hiding in the trees. There aren't too many of them, but forewarned means armed!

Your eye catches the faint swaying of the air, distorting the outlines of grass blades on the ground. As you get closer, you realize that there is an invisible casket in front of you. With some sweat, you manage to unravel the casket's secret and find the Helm of Heavenly Enlightenment inside.

Back in the day, mercenaries from all over the world would flock to these lands to join the mighty Legion's hosts. Even after his death, the monument to him kept stirring admiration in the hearts of both young soldiers and seasoned veterans. Today, however, only the base and legs of the great monument remain. Could you can find a way to restore the Statue of Legion?

The decisive battle had just died down. A fleeing enemy is trapped in the mountains, with slim chances to mount a counterattack. Your position is nigh invulnerable: you only need to go and put an end to this long war.
Key to Victory: The Second Key
It is said that the Angelic Alliance was destroyed during the war. Some also claim that the great artifact can yet be recreated if its lost parts are found.
In the backyard of an Alchemist's Lab...
Under a tall dead tree...
At the bottom of a pit flooded with the waters of the great lakes...
The leprechaun keeps a keen eye on his real treasure...
Under a cart at an old sawmill...
Unseen, it rests among the flowers planted by the students at the magic school...
Beyond these gates lie lands where no one can guarantee your safety. However, as long as you are on this side, you have nothing to fear.
Remember: by commanding your Border Guards to stand down, you will open the way not only for yourself, but also for your enemies!
Beyond these gates lie lands where no one can guarantee your safety. However, as long as you are on this side, you have nothing to fear.
Unlock the gates at your own risk! Once opened, they will no longer protect you from the enemy.
Unlock the gates at your own risk! Once opened, they will no longer protect you from the enemy.
map.[hota] king of the hill.event.0.desc: You are trembling. Either from anger, or from the actual earthquake. Those seven scoundrels, those bastards! They will pay! Your revenge will be like a firestorm. With these thoughts you ordered the standard-bearer to raise the flag of your color. The march has begun! Scarlet glow is seen far away on top of the mountain.
map.[hota] king of the hill.event.1.desc: The glow has densed on the horizon. Furthermore, the air has been filled with smallest ash particles. The mighty volcano is erupting. The castles of your enemies are standing at its side. The legend tells that deep inside there is a Heart city. The one controlling that city will be able to control the volcano's power. You grinned with your yellowed teeth and spurred your horse.
map.[hota] king of the hill.header.descr: The hatred of eight lords, like volcano, is about to erupt towards each other in a bloody war. It will get hot soon!
map.[hota] king of the hill.header.name: King of the Hill
map.[hota] king of the hill.header.rumor: No matter who will win. The volcano will erupt any moment and the flow of molten lava will destroy both the winners and the losers.
map.[hota] long road.event.0.description: You fell to thinking. How could it be that the enemy’s spies were discovered deep beyond the line of defense? They surely could not slip by your fortified garrisons, as through all the centuries your kingdom has existed, the only road binding all the towns, like beads on a thread, have existed.
map.[hota] long road.event.1.description: You heard that these lands had been regions of an ancient country long ago, and its inhabitants mastered a secret of moving to very long distances. However, this knowledge had been lost many years ago, and even your best sorcerers were unable to discover the mystery of such travels. Maybe little pieces of such knowledge are still preserved somewhere at the countryside ruined by war, but unfortunately it is definitely not in your capital.
map.[hota] long road.guards.1.28.1.messa: A poor footworn path ended when you entered into a swampy grove. But even here there is a kind of a road: a brook swirls and snaggles in the brushing and thick bog, thus making a hard but safe way for strangers.
map.[hota] long road.guards.14.1.1.messa: Beyond this garrison begin the disputed lands, battles for which are particularly cruel. There is no opportunity to maintain the road in a due state here, and rubble which somewhere replaced the paved stone of the capital, is replaced with a well-footworn ground.
map.[hota] long road.guards.18.1.0.messa: Beyond this garrison begin the disputed lands, battles for which are particularly cruel. There is no opportunity to maintain the road in a due state here, and rubble which somewhere replaced the paved stone of the capital, is replaced with a well-footworn ground.
map.[hota] long road.guards.3.33.0.messa: A mystical obelisk built here long before the first state ever appeared, divides the road in two. We could leave our quarrels behind, and each state would possess its own side of the road. But how can you stay only halfway?
map.[hota] long road.guards.3.34.1.messa: It seems you found the root of all evil. The ruins behind the monsters shine with a magic light. Can it be that forgotten roads and crossroads are alive again, and your enemy already uses it all in full?
map.[hota] long road.guards.32.33.1.mess: A mystical obelisk built here long before the first state ever appeared, divides the road in two. We could leave our quarrels behind, and each state would possess its own side of the road. But how can you stay only halfway?
map.[hota] long road.guards.34.18.0.mess: A poor footworn path ended when you entered into a swampy grove. But even here there is a kind of a road: a brook swirls and snaggles in the brushing and thick bog, thus making a hard but safe way for strangers.
map.[hota] long road.guards.34.34.0.mess: It seems you found the root of all evil. The ruins behind the monsters shine with a magic light. Can it be that forgotten roads and crossroads are alive again, and your enemy already uses it all in full?
map.[hota] long road.header.description: The struggle of two sovereigns have reminded a tug of war for decades. It is no surprise: the only road bounds the capitals of two kingdoms, and villages are doomed to change hands. But recently the spies of your enemy were discovered deep beyond the defense line. Could a back-way appear somewhere?
map.[hota] long road.header.name: Long Road
map.[hota] long road.sign.16.22.0.messag: This way shall only open to those who mastered the ancient secrets of light and darkness.
map.[hota] long road.sign.19.19.1.messag: This way shall only open to those who mastered the ancient secrets of light and darkness.
map.[hota] maelstrom.header.description: No one can predict which side the wheel of fortune turns. Try your luck, warrior, in the lands that may want you to abandon your home forever. Advance in the lands where nothing is permanent!
map.[hota] maelstrom.header.name: Maelstrom
map.[hota] marsh.event.0.description: The people of these godforsaken lands live in constant fear. Anyone daring to turn from the broad road in the thicket, does not come back... every day a few people disappear in the swamp. Someone said that this is an evil spirit’s deed. Others accuse forest animals, but no one knows the truth.
map.[hota] marsh.event.1.description: It is time to change this situation once and for all! To succeed, resolve the conflict with the other three lords that rule over these marshes. The diplomatic negotiation resulted in a stalemate. Not a single diplomat returned from the mission. Also, not a single representative of other lords has visited you. They might have perished at hands of foul spirit in the swamp... Or maybe enemy armies are marching towards you already, ready for a sneak attack! In that case, we have to forestall them!
map.[hota] marsh.header.description: The roads are clean and safe, but the one who dares to turn into a dark thicket, will gain wealth and power.
map.[hota] marsh.header.name: Marsh
map.[hota] mysterious ways.header.descri: This small realm lives by its own rules. Everything here is subject to change in a snap of fingers. New paths appear in the woods, waiting for an adventurer to set foot upon them. You will have to blaze your own way to triumph.
map.[hota] mysterious ways.header.name: Mysterious Ways
map.[hota] noble nemesis.event.0.descrip: The tribes of the wastelands have always fought for survival, but now they must unite to stand against a tyrant's rule. Can you bring them together to challenge the king’s iron fist?
map.[hota] noble nemesis.event.1.descrip: Hidden beneath the ground, the dragons are waiting. It’s time to awaken their fury and lead them to battle against the king’s reign.
map.[hota] noble nemesis.event.2.descrip: The king’s rule hasn’t reached the wastelands yet, but his influence grows. Unleash an army of machines and creatures, and tear his empire apart, screw by screw!
map.[hota] noble nemesis.event.3.descrip: In the swamps and forests, nature holds power—but it’s up to you to command it. Can you wield the forces of nature to take down the king’s army?
map.[hota] noble nemesis.event.4.descrip: Imprisoned in darkness for centuries, the Necromancers awake to reclaim their power. Now, it’s time to use the forces of death to challenge the king’s reign.
map.[hota] noble nemesis.event.5.descrip: Deep within the fiery depths, the heart of the Inferno pulses with untamed fire… With the world on the brink of chaos, will you ignite the flames of havoc and plunge it further into turmoil?
map.[hota] noble nemesis.event.6.descrip: You set sail for treasure, but you learned that the king’s reign has turned your quest into something far more exciting. Grab what you can, and maybe knock a king off his throne while you’re at it!
map.[hota] noble nemesis.event.7.descrip: At the end of the underground river stands an ancient ziggurat, holding the most powerful artifacts and spells within. To reach it, a hero must first seek the counsel of the Green Tent Keymaster.
map.[hota] noble nemesis.guards.107.76.0: The King’s dogs thought they had me cornered. Now they’ll learn I bite harder. You have my blades…
map.[hota] noble nemesis.guards.175.41.0: These are The King's items! What are you doing here?!
map.[hota] noble nemesis.guards.193.79.1: The dragons in the cave look friendly… and seem to be reproducing?
You didn't think it would come at no cost, did you now?
map.[hota] noble nemesis.guards.216.11.1: The blade burns with promise… but you are not the only one drawn to it. The guardians stir—as if chaos itself defends its own.
map.[hota] noble nemesis.guards.216.18.1: The eternal flame stirs courage, luck, and magic deep within.

map.[hota] noble nemesis.guards.222.11.1: The heat crushes not just bodies, but spirit. Your troops march… without conviction.

Patience brought you here, as it did me. Victory required endurance, but so did the making of this very path.

Take this final gift, traveler. I salute your perseverance.

With gratitude—and my best wishes to you and your kin.

Farewell.

map.[hota] noble nemesis.header.descript: A cruel king reigns over the land with an iron fist. As tension builds, who will dare to challenge his rule—and at what cost?
map.[hota] noble nemesis.header.name: Noble Nemesis
map.[hota] noble nemesis.heroes.110.biog: Grulk commands the Cyclopes not with words, but with chains and fear. He keeps them fed, focused, and facing the right direction—usually. No one’s sure who’s more dangerous: the monsters in the cage, or the one holding the key.
map.[hota] noble nemesis.heroes.118.biog: Once bred for war, Gorgthak found purpose in chains and walls. Now he guards the angelic prison with brutal pride, crushing escape and mercy alike. Rumors say he’s never slept—only growled. Even demons keep their distance.
map.[hota] noble nemesis.heroes.127.biog: Born in the black waters where the sun never reaches, Zsarr'khan speaks the tongue of swamp and serpent alike. Her eyes burn like drowned fireflies, and the marsh shifts at her command. Some say the swamp isn't guarded by her—it is her.
map.[hota] noble nemesis.heroes.152.biog: Clad in scorched iron and dragonhide, Varguk calls himself King of the Bad Orcs. He feeds prisoners to wyrmlings and sings to the flames. Even dragons give him space—and that's saying something.
map.[hota] noble nemesis.heroes.20.biogr: Orphaned as a child, Ufretin was raised in the northernmost forests of AvLee. He became known throughout the land for his exceptional ability to resist magic of all kinds.
map.[hota] noble nemesis.heroes.23.biogr: They say Grashka once took down a wyvern with a rusty hook and half a plan. She never speaks of her past—only sharpens her blades by the fire. When she laughs, someone usually dies.
map.[hota] noble nemesis.heroes.31.biogr: Thalanar is said to have been born from the first storm beneath the worldroot. His presence bends light, calms beasts, and silences lies. Few know if he protects the cavern—or if the cavern dreamed him into being.
Finally! I will tell the boys to resume the mining.
The Amulet of the Undertaker lies buried deep in the King’s ore mine. Care to fetch it for me? I could help you organize the miners.
Still poking around the tunnels? The ore mine won’t give up its secrets that easily.

Excellent! The Scroll of Resurrection is ready—life bends under our hands once more.

Well, that’s settled—what survived the fight now marches with us.

The battle rages on, and the Rust Dragons aren’t giving up… Are you still holding back?
The King has fallen, and the path between worlds is open. Step through and leave the old reign behind.

The sand won’t turn itself, you know… ready to lend a hand, or just let it stay barren?
map.[hota] noble nemesis.quest.132.149.0: The final offering is made, and the parchment sings with power. Take this Scroll of Resurrection—the breath of life itself is now yours to command.
A whisper of life beyond death, held within a single scroll. For a proper tribute of resources, we shall craft the Scroll of Resurrection—a treasure coveted by all who fear loss.
You are on the right path, but life cannot yet return. The Scroll of Resurrection requires more—return with the remaining resources.
Well done. With your gifts complete, the parchment opens. The Scroll of Remove Obstacle is yours—paths clear at your command.
Once again, the world is filled with barriers. Only those who pay the price in resources may claim the Scroll of Remove Obstacle. Will you prove worthy?
The resources flow, but the inkpot is not yet full. The Scroll of Remove Obstacle remains unwritten—complete the offering.
The offering is whole! The ink ripples like a tide upon the page. Take this Scroll of Water Walk—step boldly across the waters.
The seas and rivers bow to those who bear the Scroll of Water Walk. Bring us the rarest resources, and we shall inscribe it for you to walk where others must sail.
You are partway there, but the waters remain off-limits yet. Complete your tribute, and the Scroll of Water Walk shall be ready.
The portal shimmers upon parchment—a gift completed. Take this Scroll of Town Portal, and travel as you will, in but a breath.
Imagine never being lost, always returning home upon saying a word. With the right resources, we shall grant you a Scroll of Town Portal—the gateway to safety and swiftness.
You’ve started well, but the gates remain closed. Only when all resources are offered will the Scroll of Town Portal open its path to you.
The last stone falls. Take this Scroll of Remove Obstacle—no hindrance shall withstand you.
The walls rise again, the stones block your way. With the proper tribute, the Scroll of Remove Obstacle shall once more be written for you.
Your offering is incomplete, and the obstacles remain. Return with the final resources, and the scroll shall be finished.
The final spark ignites! Take the Scroll of Berserk—may its fire turn battle into chaos and victory.
A dangerous power, yet a glorious one—the Scroll of Berserk. For a worthy tribute of resources, we shall unleash it into your hands.
Your offerings stir the parchment, but fury does not yet awaken. The Scroll of Berserk still waits for completion.
Your resources are delivered in full. The ink flows; the spell awakens. Take this Scroll of Remove Obstacle—may every wall before you crumble.
Yet again, traveler, the world places barriers before you. Offer the needed resources, and we shall scribe another Scroll of Remove Obstacle to clear your journey.
The quills rest, waiting for the last of your tribute. Until the full offering is made, the Scroll of Remove Obstacle cannot be completed.
Splendid! The resources are delivered, the quills dance, and the spell is written. Accept your Scroll of Remove Obstacle—may no barrier stand in your way.

Welcome, traveler! You’ve found the finest scroll shop in the world. Our knowledge is vast, our magic precise. Bring us the required resources, and we shall inscribe for you a Scroll of Remove Obstacle—the art of clearing any path.

map.[hota] noble nemesis.quest.39.60.1.1: Here’s your Dragon Wing Tabard. Try not to burn it… or yourself.
Bring me 5,000 gold, and I’ll part with a Dragon Wing Tabard. I’m feeling generous… for now.
Still holding onto that gold? I might start charging interest.
Finally! The Black Dragons are fed.
I need 500 Infernal Troglodytes, 200 Harpy Hags, 140 Evil Eyes, and 70 Medusas—the dragons are starving, and we need to feed them properly.
Still hunting those fiends? Don’t keep my dragons waiting—they’re growing impatient.
Well, well, a rainbow of dragons all in one place—finally, some entertainment.
I need 25 Gold, 25 Ghost, 25 Black, 3 Faerie, and 3 Rust Dragons—time to brew something truly spectacular.
Dragging your feet? These dragons won’t gather themselves, you know.
Looks like the Reds finally found their cousins—cheers to a colorful reunion.
I need 50 Red Dragons—let’s see if they play nice this time.
Still chasing those fiery divas? Don’t let a single one slip away.
Gather 50 Gold, 50 Ghost, 50 Black, 6 Faerie, and 6 Rust Dragons—let’s cook up a little azure magic.
Still juggling the horde? Don’t let any of these melodramatic beasts wander off.
The King has fallen. Take to the skies—fly like a dragon, if you dare.
Time to settle old scores—The King won’t be waiting politely.
Remember, the throne room won’t clean itself; the King still stands in your way.
map.[hota] noble nemesis.quest.39.60.1.2: Here’s your Red Dragon Flame Tongue. Careful—it still burns.
Fetch me a Red Dragon—alive, dead, or smoldering. I need its flame for… personal projects.
Still waiting for that Red Dragon. Don’t tell me it roasted you already.
map.[hota] noble nemesis.quest.39.60.1.3: Well, the labyrinth’s a mess no more—here, take 12 Minotaurs and try not to break anything… too badly.
I need 80 Troglodytes and 25 Harpies to clean out a local labyrinth. Dragons won’t step in there—too dusty, too many cobwebs, and apparently "it smells funny."
Still missing some Trogs and Harpies.
map.[hota] noble nemesis.quest.39.60.1.4: Freedom agrees with her—take your black dragon and see what trouble you can stir.
Mutare Drake’s been sulking in a cell—time someone reminded her what freedom feels like.
Mutare Drake’s been sulking in a cell—time someone reminded her what freedom feels like.
map.[hota] noble nemesis.quest.39.60.1.5: Well, that’s a mouthful of success—take the Necklace of Dragon Teeth.
I need some bony friends to help me with a little… personal project.
I need some bony friends to help me with a little… personal project.
map.[hota] noble nemesis.quest.39.60.1.6: Those naughty Faerie Dragons are finally in line—take some sulfur from my personal collection.
Some Faerie Dragons have been causing mischief, stealing shiny things and ignoring their oaths. Time to teach them a lesson.
Those cheeky little wings are still fluttering about—don’t let them slip away.
map.[hota] noble nemesis.quest.39.60.1.7: Three of each—Green, Bone, and Red—lined up nicely. Dragon Scale Shield is ready; let’s see it in action.
I need three Green, three Bone, and three Red Dragons—don’t ask why, just collect them.
Still short on dragons—remember, three of each color, and make it quick.
map.[hota] noble nemesis.quest.39.60.1.8: Perfect feast! Twelve Black Dragons are more than satisfied—let’s see what mischief they cause next.
Dragons are getting peckish. Bring me 200 Infernal Troglodytes, 100 Harpy Hags, 70 Evil Eyes, and 50 Medusa Queens to sate their appetites.
Still gathering the monsters? The dragons won’t wait forever—they’re hungry.
map.[hota] noble nemesis.quest.39.60.1.9: Excellent! The dragons delivered—your Dragon Scale Armor is ready.
I need a colorful mix of 5 Green, 5 Bone, and 5 Red Dragons—trust me, it’s for something spectacular.
I need a colorful mix of 5 Green, 5 Bone, and 5 Red Dragons—trust me, it’s for something spectacular.
map.[hota] noble nemesis.quest.39.60.1.c: Good. Let’s get down to business.
map.[hota] noble nemesis.quest.39.60.1.f: Dragons—majestic alive, priceless dead. I take them either way. Do you like them as well?
map.[hota] noble nemesis.quest.39.60.1.n: Dragons—majestic alive, priceless dead. I take them either way. Do you like them as well?
As the scroll’s magic takes hold, the ancient stone trembles, crumbles, and fades into dust.
This ancient stone has stood here for centuries. Only magic could undo its hold on this land.
This ancient stone has stood here for centuries. Only magic could undo its hold on this land.
With the Scroll of Dispel in hand, the magic fades. The gate swings open, revealing the path beyond.
A mysterious gate hums with ancient magic, resisting all attempts to open it. Perhaps the key lies beyond a town gate.
A mysterious gate hums with ancient magic, resisting all attempts to open it. Perhaps the key lies beyond a town gate.
Good. The Halflings are caged and ready. Here’s your 10 Orc Chieftains—strong and loyal.
These Halflings keep sneaking past our borders, thinking they’re clever. Bring me 30 of ’em, and I’ll trade you 10 Orc Chieftains—real muscle for real control.
The Halflings don’t know what’s coming. Don’t waste time—round ’em up before they vanish again.
The Rust Dragons feast once more. Take these 50 fearsome beasts—they owe their strength to your efforts.
Remember my old dragon friend? He’s hungry again and needs more—gather 1,000 Hobgoblins, 500 Wolf Raiders, 350 Orc Chieftains, 150 Ogre Magi, and 150 Thunderbirds to feed his Rust Dragons.
The dragon’s hunger grows. Keep bringing Hobgoblins, Wolf Raiders, Orc Chieftains, Ogre Magi, and Thunderbirds for the Rust Dragons.
The King lies slain. The path is open now—take what’s yours and rise beyond the battle.
The King sits upon a throne of blood and fire. It’s time to bring his empire crashing down.
The King still holds court. Steel yourself—this battle will decide everything.
Got ’em! Now the gold’s yours. Let’s keep the Stronghold tight—no thieves allowed.
Some slippery Rogues been pickin’ pockets and runnin’ wild in the northern cave. Track ’em down and bring ’em to me—there’s 5,000 gold in it for you.
Those Rogues won’t wait forever. Find ’em in the northern cave and put an end to their thievin’ ways.
Kilgor’s loose. Take these 6 Ogre Magi and show them how to fight.
Kilgor’s locked up, but the Stronghold needs his firepower. Break him out.
Don’t forget—free Kilgor from that prison.
The monsters are dead, and the fort is ours again. Take these 25 Orc Chieftains—make ’em count.
There’s an old orc fort out in the wasteland, now crawling with monsters. Kill ’em.
The Wasteland fort’s still crawling with monsters.
The beasts are gathered. Take these 16 Rocs—your wings for the war.
I need 75 Hobgoblins, 30 Wolf Raiders, and 20 Ogres—trade ’em for 16 Rocs. Strong flyers for strong raids.
Still waiting on those Hobgoblins, Wolf Raiders, and Ogres. Get ’em ready for the Rocs.
Ogres delivered. Take these 12 Cyclopes—crushers for your cause.
Bring me 30 Ogres, and I’ll hand over 12 Cyclopes. Bigger fists, bigger damage.
Ogres still needed. Don’t keep those Cyclopes waiting.
You’ve brought the might. Take these 18 Behemoths—giants ready to crush.
Gather 200 Hobgoblins, 100 Wolf Raiders, 50 Orc Chieftains, and 25 Ogres. Bring ‘em all, and I’ll send 18 Behemoths your way. Time to stomp.
The army’s not complete. Hobgoblins, Raiders, Chieftains, and Ogres—all still needed.
The feast is served. Take these 7 Rust Dragons—fiery allies with an iron bite.
I’ve got a unique deal with my dragon keeper friend—his dragons are starving. Bring 300 Hobgoblins, 50 Ogres, 60 Thunderbirds, and 40 Earth Elementals as food.
The dragon keeper’s waiting on that feast. Still need Hobgoblins, Ogres, Thunderbirds, and Elementals.
The ancient Behemoths have risen, thunder shaking the earth.
We found an ancient behemoth cave. To wake up the Behemoths, we will need 400 Hobgoblins, 200 Wolf Raiders, 100 Orc Chieftains, 50 Ogre Magi, 10 Hydras, and 150 Halflings.
Gather the Hobgoblins, Wolf Raiders, Orc Chieftains, Ogre Magi, Hydras, and Halflings to awaken the Behemoths.
Hungry for work, or will you crumble?
I’m Gromak, Slave Master of the Stronghold. Prove your worth or rot in chains—ready for your first task?
Don’t forget—only the strong survive here. Show me you can handle what I ask.
map.[hota] noble nemesis.quest.47.20.0.1: Four become one—Master Genies now dance under your command.
Breathe life into all four—air, earth, fire, and water—and watch them ascend.
Breathe life into all four—air, earth, fire, and water—and watch them ascend.
map.[hota] noble nemesis.quest.47.20.0.2: Four become one—Master Genies now dance under your command.
Breathe life into all four—air, earth, fire, and water—and watch them ascend.
Breathe life into all four—air, earth, fire, and water—and watch them ascend.
map.[hota] noble nemesis.quest.47.20.0.3: Four become one—Master Genies now dance under your command.
Breathe life into all four—air, earth, fire, and water—and watch them ascend.
Breathe life into all four—air, earth, fire, and water—and watch them ascend.
map.[hota] noble nemesis.quest.47.20.0.c: Four become one—Master Genies now dance under your command.
map.[hota] noble nemesis.quest.47.20.0.f: Breathe life into all four—air, earth, fire, and water—and watch them ascend.
map.[hota] noble nemesis.quest.47.20.0.n: Breathe life into all four—air, earth, fire, and water—and watch them ascend.
map.[hota] noble nemesis.quest.49.43.0.c: The tomes have spoken—your mind expands, and knowledge flows like ink through parchment.
map.[hota] noble nemesis.quest.49.43.0.f: The ancient library welcomes only those who value wisdom. Offer 15,000 gold, and its secrets may be yours.
map.[hota] noble nemesis.quest.49.43.0.n: The ancient library welcomes only those who value wisdom. Offer 15,000 gold, and its secrets may be yours.
The Nymphs dance in the glade once more. Here’s some wood—may it serve you well.
The forest thrives on balance. Offer 30 Nymphs to aid the woodland.
The Nymphs stir the trees and streams, working to restore the forest’s harmony.
The Wyverns’ call was answered; 300 Wyvern Monarchs now soar under our banner.
The Wyverns have called for our help. Gather Gnolls, Lizard Warriors, Mighty Gorgons, Dragon Flies, and Greater Basilisks to answer their call.
The Wyverns have called for our help. Gather Gnolls, Lizard Warriors, Mighty Gorgons, Dragon Flies, and Greater Basilisks to answer their call.
The King lies defeated, his shadow lifted from the land. The power of Dimension Door is yours—use it wisely.
The forest whispers of the final challenge: The King must fall. Step forth and end his reign.
The forest whispers of the final challenge: The King must fall. Step forth and end his reign.
The ritual's song calls forth new allies—5 Sea Witches join our cause.
I need 8 Satyrs for an ancient ritual.
Still waiting on those 8 Satyrs.
The wild energy flows strong; 5 Nix have answered the call.
We need 3 Trolls and 90 Nymphs to channel their wild energy.
The forest’s magic waits—gather 3 Trolls and 90 Nymphs.
The forest breathes easier now—the Vampire's reign is over, and the Boots of Speed are yours to claim.
A Vampire Lord stalks the shadows, threatening our sacred woods.
The Vampire Lord still haunts the forest—track him down and end his menace.
The ancient earth ritual is complete. The Scroll of Slow is now yours—use it wisely.
We need rare elements for an ancient earth ritual—12 mercury, sulfur, crystal, and gems each, plus 3,000 gold.
The ritual awaits its components—bring the elements to proceed.
Sea Serpents answer the call. The forest and sea unite in harmony.
The wild demands balance. 100 Gnoll Marauders, 50 Lizard Warriors, 40 Dragon Flies, and 100 Nymphs are needed.
Still gathering the wild forces? Bring the Gnolls, Lizard Warriors, Dragon Flies, and Nymphs.
Trolls and Satyrs uncovered the Wyvern nests—50 fierce Wyverns now ride with us!
We need 18 Trolls and 80 Satyrs to look for Wyvern nests. Let the forest skies roar with new wings.
The Wyverns await—bring the Trolls and Satyrs to summon their fury.
The swamp is alive!
We gather Lizard Warriors, Gorgons, Dragon Flies, Basilisks, and Nymphs to transform the swamp into mighty Hydra ponds.
The swamp waits—gather Lizard Warriors, Gorgons, Dragon Flies, Basilisks, and Nymphs to raise the Hydra ponds.
The forest hums with power—with our spell complete, Faerie Dragons now grace the enchanted woods.
Gather Dragon Flies, Greater Basilisks, Earth and Water Elementals, Enchanters, and Leprechauns. They will work to enchant the forest.
Gather Dragon Flies, Greater Basilisks, Earth and Water Elementals, Enchanters, and Leprechauns. They will work to enchant the forest.
The forest watches you now. Ready to prove your worth among the trees?
I am Sylwen, guardian of these ancient woods. If you seek harmony with nature, you’ve come to the right place.
I am Sylwen, guardian of these ancient woods. If you seek harmony with nature, you’ve come to the right place.
You have reclaimed the pendant. The spirits stir with approval; your path grows stronger.
The spirits whisper of a pendant stolen by goblins, hidden within their village to the west. Find it.
The goblins’ village lies to the west—retrieve the pendant.
The offering is complete, and the spirits have blessed us. Take your gold and ready yourself for what’s next.
The spirits demand a greater offering—forty mercury, forty sulfur, and forty gems. Gather them well; the ritual grows stronger.
Still waiting on those forty mercury, sulfur, and gems. The spirits won’t wait forever.
You’ve reached level 40—the spirits honor your journey. Here’s the Scroll of Water Walk; carry it wisely.
Reach level 40—prove your strength to the spirits.
Keep climbing toward level 40.
You delivered every piece. The ritual is complete—take this 90,000 gold as a token of the spirits’ favor.
I need these materials to craft a powerful ritual—wood, mercury, ore, sulfur, crystal, and gems. Gather them for me.
The ritual won’t wait. Bring me the wood, mercury, ore, sulfur, crystal, and gems I asked for.
The King lies defeated. The way is open—take this Dimension Door spell and step where few dare to follow.
The King stands as the final obstacle. Bring him down, and you’ll earn a power that bends space itself.
The King’s reign won’t end itself. Take him down and claim what’s waiting beyond the veil.
Boragus walks free once more. The spirits shift—now you move swifter on the path ahead.
The winds carry word of Boragus, held captive and broken in chains. Free him from his prison—our cause needs his strength.
Boragus remains behind bars; time to break his bonds and bring him home.
The ritual grows stronger, and the spirits watch with favor.
The shaman’s ritual calls for the strength of a Hydra’s heart. Bring one to fuel the ancient brew.
The Hydra’s power is still needed to complete the shaman’s potion.
With these gifts, the shaman’s brew is complete. The spirits whisper promises of fortune and fury.
To harness the spirits’ wrath, the shaman needs rare elements—mercury, sulfur, and gems.
The ritual’s power hinges on those precious elements. Gather them soon, or the spirits grow restless.
The scroll is ready—woven with my will and nature’s power. Use it well to slow those who stand in your way.
I need wood, mercury, ore, sulfur, crystal, and gems—rare gifts to craft a scroll that can slow even the quickest foe.
The spirits grow restless. Bring me the materials so I may finish the scroll.
Excellent. Here is your reward.
I require mercury, sulfur, and gems to complete a powerful ritual. I will pay you well.
The ritual’s power hinges on these offerings. Gather them, so I may proceed.
You’ve reached the needed might. Take the scroll and clear the path.
Sharpen your strike—reach an Attack value of 25. Only then can you claim the scroll that clears the path.
Your strength grows, but you’re not there yet. Push harder—an Attack value of 25 is expected.
With these offerings, the ritual gains power. Take your gold and ready yourself for what comes next.
I need rare elements—mercury, sulfur, and gems. Gather thirty of each; the spirits favor those who prepare well.
The elements are still needed—mercury, sulfur, and gems, thirty each. Don’t falter.
With these sacred elements, the power to restore breath is within reach.
To bring life back from the grip of death, I need mercury, sulfur, crystal, and gems.
The ritual awaits your offerings—mercury, sulfur, crystal, and gems, in the needed amounts. The spirits grow restless.
Now, prepare yourself—the true ritual is about to begin.
I am Zarkul, Shaman of the Canyon. The spirits whisper of a great task—one that only the bold can face.
The spirits’ call remains strong—are you ready to prove yourself?
map.[hota] noble nemesis.quest.56.40.0.c: The gates of the Ancient Library open before you.
map.[hota] noble nemesis.quest.56.40.0.f: The path to the Ancient Library is sealed. Only an offering of 40 Gems will grant you entry.
map.[hota] noble nemesis.quest.56.40.0.n: You have not yet delivered the full tribute of 40 Gems. The library remains closed.
Take these Wayfarer’s boots, Drakon—prepare yourself for the war to come.
Your first mission: eliminate the guards at Drakon’s prison. Bring him back—alive.
Drakon’s fate hangs on you. Don’t fail.
The King falls. The Guild’s shadow spreads. Take this Fly Spell—your wings to escape, or hunt anew.
The Guild’s final order: end The King’s reign. Fail, and there’ll be no next time.
The King’s days are numbered.
The Assassins’ Guild moves forward on its own terms. Take these Equestrian's Gloves—ready yourself for what lies ahead.
One Rogue is needed for a delicate task—fail, and it’ll be your last.
The risk is real, but the prize is worth it.
Mercenary leader’s down. Your gold awaits.
Mercenary leader been stirring trouble. Take him out before he causes more chaos.
He’s still breathing. Finish the job.
The materials arrived. Our tools just got deadlier. Here’s your share.
Supplies are low—need rare crystals, mercury, and gems to craft silent poisons and sharp blades.
Still waiting on those precious ingredients. Get moving.
The price of loyalty has been paid—10,000 gold.
Adrienne the witch holds secrets we need—find her and bring her to us.
Time’s ticking. The Assassins’ Guild can’t afford delays.
With these in hand, no door will hold against us. Take one too.
For the next step in our craft, we need 10 mercury, sulfur, crystal, and gems to forge a way past any barrier.
Gather what’s needed. No obstacle should slow us down.
With these, we move faster and strike harder. 25,000 gold is yours.
To sharpen our edge, bring 20 mercury, crystal, and gems. We’re gearing up for what’s next.
Keep the supplies flowing—our work demands it.
Mission accomplished. We secured the Resurrection Scroll along the way—consider it a gift from the Guild.
The Guild needs resources to retrieve a lost ally from the brink—30 of each element to secure his way back from death itself.
The mission’s on—keep the supplies coming.
Our grip tightens with your help. Take your 90,000 gold and prepare—control is within our grasp.
The Guild’s network grows—40 of each resource are needed to fuel our next level of influence.
Your haul strengthens our reach. Keep it flowing.
You lookin’ for work, or just scouting the shadows?
This is the Assassins’ Guild. I’m Kaelen, the one who decides who lives and who doesn’t. Prove you’re worth the shadows’ time.
I am watching. Don’t disappoint.
map.[hota] noble nemesis.quest.57.64.1.1: Finally, someone who acts! The Emblem is ours—let’s see what mischief we can brew next.
I need that Emblem of Cognizance from the dragon tower to the west. Think you can snatch it for me, or are you all talk?
Still thinking it over? That Emblem won’t steal itself—time to get moving.
Ah, splendid! Everything’s in place—let the gold flow.
I’ve got a rather… expensive potion to brew. Can you fetch the ingredients?
Still dragging your feet? Those ingredients aren’t going to appear by magic.
Finally! The King has fallen… now, step through to wherever you wish.
The time has come to face the King himself. Ready to dance with destiny?
Hesitation won’t slay royalty—don’t keep me waiting.
map.[hota] noble nemesis.quest.57.64.1.2: Well, look at you—Mutare’s out and on the move. Let’s see where this little jailbreak leads us.
Mutare’s locked up, and I need her out—can you break her free, or are you scared of a little jailhouse fun?
Hesitating? Mutare’s not going to pick the locks herself—you know what to do.
map.[hota] noble nemesis.quest.57.64.1.3: Perfect! Everything’s here—the brew is a success. Here is your payment.
I need these materials to brew a rare potion—think you can gather them for me?
map.[hota] noble nemesis.quest.57.64.1.4: Brilliant, the vial is ready—time to stir up some trouble!
I need these rare components for a vial of dragon blood—help me out, or are you planning to nap instead?
Still thinking? Dragons don’t wait for indecisive heroes.
map.[hota] noble nemesis.quest.57.64.1.5: Perfect! The Scroll of Slow is simmered to perfection—now, let’s see who gets slowed first!
I’m brewing a tricky little spell, but I’m short on ingredients—help me gather them, or do you prefer watching me fume alone?
Tick-tock! The cauldron isn’t getting any fuller on its own.
map.[hota] noble nemesis.quest.57.64.1.6: Ah, splendid! Everything’s in place, and the brew is complete—let’s see what this little masterpiece does.
I need these rare bits and bobs for a… delicate little experiment. Care to lend a hand, or would you rather watch me mutter to myself?
The pile’s still pitifully small—your ingredients are missing in action.
map.[hota] noble nemesis.quest.57.64.1.7: Perfect! The mixture is ready—obstacles won’t know what hit them.
I’m brewing something that could make walls and barriers… politely disappear. Help me gather the bits?
Still short on ingredients—don’t make me resort to begging dragons for help.
map.[hota] noble nemesis.quest.57.64.1.8: Excellent! Everything’s in place—this is going to be very profitable.
I have a little project that needs a… colorful collection of materials. Care to fetch them for me?
map.[hota] noble nemesis.quest.57.64.1.9: Perfect! All set—this scroll will do wonders when the time comes.
I need a few ingredients for a delicate little ritual—think you can handle it?
Don’t tell me you’ve lost your nerve; those ingredients won’t gather themselves.
map.[hota] noble nemesis.quest.57.64.1.c: Finally, someone with sense! Let’s begin with your first task—I have plans that require a steady hand.
map.[hota] noble nemesis.quest.57.64.1.f: Ah, welcome to my little hideaway. I have a delicate task that requires… a willing hand. Care to lend yours?
map.[hota] noble nemesis.quest.57.64.1.n: Oh, I see… hesitation suits some, but the task won’t complete itself. Will you reconsider?
map.[hota] noble nemesis.quest.6.247.1.1: A fine haul! And with that, twenty stout seamen be ready to sail under yer flag.
A storm took the Sea Vulture to the depths, just east o’ here. Fetch me the Pendant o’ Death from her wreck, and we’ll see ye get a proper welcome.
The Sea Vulture waits on the rocks… bring me that cursed pendant if ye’ve the spine.
The trade’s done—fifty Nix now dance under your flag. Weird? Sure. Effective? Absolutely.
Got a weird shipment order for ya: 100 Gnolls, 50 Lizardmen, 150 Nymphs, 100 Seamen, and 50 Ayssids. Think of it like a pirate’s swap meet—trade ’em in for 50 Nix. Strange but profitable.
Keep those odd recruits coming. This swap’s gonna turn heads in the tavern.
Trade’s done. Ninety Haspids ready to snap and crackle under your command.
Got a wild bunch to deliver: 100 Lizardmen, 300 Sea Dogs, 500 Nymphs, 300 Seamen, and 100 Sorceresses. Swap ’em out for 90 Haspids—think of it as upgrading your crew’s bite.
Keep the crew movin’. These Haspids won’t catch themselves.
The deal’s done—sixty Faerie Dragons now dance to your tune. Bright, flashy, and a bit cheeky, just like a true pirate’s crew.
A wild mix this time: 50 Chaos Hydras, 100 Water Elementals, 100 Nix Warriors, and 300 Ayssids. Trade ’em for 60 Faerie Dragons—fancy little beasts to light up any fleet.
Keep the magic flowin’. Those Faerie Dragons won’t hatch themselves.
The King’s reign is done. You’ve earned a gift fit for a pirate king—one that’ll lift you above the tides.
The time’s come, matey—The King’s throne won’t hold for long. Sharpen yer cutlass, rally the crew, and show him the wrath of the seas.
No turning back now. The King waits, but he won’t escape the storm you’re about to unleash.
map.[hota] noble nemesis.quest.6.247.1.2: Well now, ye look the part. Fifty Rogues stand ready to slip aboard in silence.
A true pirate knows when to vanish. There’s a Scroll o’ Disguise on the rocky isle north o’ here—fetch it, and I’ll set ye up with a crew that knows shadows.
That rocky isle waits for no man… bring me the scroll, and I’ll bring ye Rogues.
map.[hota] noble nemesis.quest.6.247.1.3: Bidley’s free and grateful. Here—5,000 gold. The taverns will be singin’ your name tonight.
Word is, Captain Bidley rots in a prison cell. Free him, and your name’ll spread faster than rum on shore leave.
map.[hota] noble nemesis.quest.6.247.1.4: Tark walks free again. Here’s 7,500 gold… and another word in your growing legend.
Tark, the Nix captain, was taken in a raid. Bring him back, and your legend will grow deeper than the sea.
Find Tark before the fishfolk forget his name—and yours.
map.[hota] noble nemesis.quest.6.247.1.5: The tavern’s repaired—and we’ve already got visitors. Thirty Corsairs looking to join your crew.
The tavern’s roof leaks and the floorboards groan. Bring me fifty crew to help rebuild.
Still need more hands before the tavern’s fit for true pirates.
map.[hota] noble nemesis.quest.6.247.1.6: The Oceanids and Witches have arrived. The lads came running—forty Pirates join your crew.
A fine tavern needs more than rum—it needs charm. Bring me a hundred Oceanids and five Sea Witches.
Still waiting on the ladies—no crew’s complete without ‘em.
map.[hota] noble nemesis.quest.6.247.1.7: The tavern’s bigger and stranger now. Thirteen Nix have found their berth under your flag.
The tavern’s gettin’ crowded—these Nix need a place to crash. Bring me ten of each rare resource, and we’ll make room for these strange folks.
Gather the goods—the Nix won’t settle where they don’t feel at home.
map.[hota] noble nemesis.quest.6.247.1.8: Emblem secured. Sixteen Sorceresses reckon you’re worthy now—seems that little trinket means a lot to ’em.
Word is, Skullhaven’s graveyard holds the Emblem of Cognizance—a trinket those Sorceresses swear by. Snag it, and you’ll earn their respect.
Don’t keep the ladies waitin’. That Emblem’s the key to their power, and it’s just sittin’ in the shadows.
map.[hota] noble nemesis.quest.6.247.1.9: Those Haspids are proof enough. Here’s the Sea Captain’s Hat—wear it like you own the waves.
Every true pirate needs the ultimate sea trophy. Bring me five Haspids—show you’re captain material.
The sea’s waiting. Don’t keep the Haspids hangin’, or your claim’s just talk.
map.[hota] noble nemesis.quest.6.247.1.c: Please take this scroll to my friend Finn by the shore. Meanwhile, are you interested in some other work?
map.[hota] noble nemesis.quest.6.247.1.f: Welcome t’ the Black Gull Tavern, matey. I be Roderick the barkeep, and this here be where every true pirate’s tale begins.
map.[hota] noble nemesis.quest.6.247.1.n: Welcome t’ the Black Gull Tavern, matey. I be Roderick the barkeep, and this here be where every true pirate’s tale begins.
map.[hota] noble nemesis.quest.64.30.0.1: With all items and the 2,000 gold provided, the Scroll of Summon Boat is yours!
Our scroll shop offers a rare treasure: a Scroll of Summon Boat. Bring 5 mercury, 5 sulfur, 5 crystal, 5 gems, and 2,000 gold to claim it.
The Scroll of Summon Boat awaits, but you have not yet delivered 5 mercury, 5 sulfur, 5 crystal, 5 gems, and 2,000 gold.
map.[hota] noble nemesis.quest.64.30.0.2: Gelu the Ranger stands before us! The Scroll of Remove Obstacle is now yours.
We seek the skilled Gelu the Ranger. Bring him here, and a Scroll of Remove Obstacle will be yours.
Gelu the Ranger has not yet arrived. Bring him to us to claim the Scroll of Remove Obstacle.
map.[hota] noble nemesis.quest.64.30.0.c: Varguk falls, and the 30,000 gold bounty is yours.
map.[hota] noble nemesis.quest.64.30.0.f: The fearsome dragon keeper, Varguk, dwells in the cave to the northeast. His head carries a bounty of 30,000 gold. Defeat him to claim both gold and glory.
map.[hota] noble nemesis.quest.64.30.0.n: Varguk still guards the icy cave. The 30,000 gold bounty waits for the brave.
Some nomads have united, and 25 of them decide to help you fight the king!
Nomads from all corners are restless, longing for a cause. Shall we rally them and see who’s brave enough to fight alongside us?
They’re gathering slowly… some hesitate, others sharpen their weapons. Patience, the strong will come.
map.[hota] noble nemesis.quest.7.230.1.1: Good haul! With that scroll delivered, here—these Equestrian's Gloves’ll help steady your grip on deck.
Before you dive deep, swing by the pirate village and chat with the barkeep. He’s got a scroll to keep you dry—Protection from Water.
Talk to the barkeep and get that scroll. It’s like a good net for rough seas.
Took the new boat for a spin, and wouldn’t ya know it—I fished up this scroll for ye!
Need rare goods—30 mercury, 10 sulfur, 30 crystal, and 30 gems—to craft a fine boat fit for the fiercest seas.
Still waitin’ on those treasures—can’t set sail without ’em.
The sea’s calm once more, thanks to you. Here’s 55,000 gold for your trouble, sailor.
The sea’s brewing a storm—I need 120 Water Elementals to keep her tamed. Fetch ’em if ye dare.
Still waitin’ on those slippery Elementals. Don’t let ’em swim away.
Well blow me down! All that shiny junk turned into 90,000 gold—best investment this side of the seven seas!
Lookin’ to turn this shack into a treasure palace. Bring me 40 wood, mercury, ore, sulfur, crystal, and gems—all the shiny bits.
No shortcuts, matey—I’m countin’ on every last shiny bit.
The King’s fallen! The seas whisper your name now. Take this scroll—a door to anywhere, for a pirate worthy of legends.
The King’s reign ends now—sail into his lair and send him to the depths. Glory and legend await, if ye survive.
The crown’s heavy, but yer cutlass is heavier. Go on—finish what ye started.
map.[hota] noble nemesis.quest.7.230.1.2: Well done! I fished these Boots of Speed out of the sea myself. Ready for what’s next?
There’s a pirate raising a stir near the village docks. Take him down—he’s got a treasure worth chasing.
That pirate won’t wait forever. Claim his prize and be quick about it.
map.[hota] noble nemesis.quest.7.230.1.3: The pier’s looking solid now. The coffers got a little fatter too—here’s 5,000 gold. What’s next?
We need sturdy wood to shore up the pier—nothing worse than creaking boards when the tide’s high.
Get that wood quick. The pier won’t fix itself.
map.[hota] noble nemesis.quest.7.230.1.4: Nice haul! With this scroll, your boat will be at your beck and call. Fancy a sail?
The sea’s been stubborn lately. Bring me 12 water elementals to calm it down.
Don’t keep the tides waiting—fetch those water elementals, and I’ll show you a trick.
map.[hota] noble nemesis.quest.7.230.1.5: Here’s 12,000 gold for your trouble. What’s next?
Catchin’ big fish calls for bigger bait. Bring me 50 Lizardmen. Sharp teeth, slippery scales—the perfect lure.
No time to waste. The fish won’t bait themselves.
map.[hota] noble nemesis.quest.7.230.1.6: Ye took that beast down good—Skullhaven’s lights burn bright again. That necklace’s all yours, savvy?
A foul beast haunts the Skullhaven lighthouse, blocking safe passage. Take it down and claim the lighthouse.
That beast won’t clear itself—show it who rules these waters.
map.[hota] noble nemesis.quest.7.230.1.7: With this fancy gear, I’ll catch treasures galore! Here’s 12,500 gold for your trouble—now, who’s ready to fish?
Need to upgrade me gear—bring 5 wood, 10 mercury, 5 ore, 10 crystal, and 10 gems. Only the finest for a fisherman’s best life.
Still waiting on that treasure haul—don’t keep me castin’ in empty waters.
map.[hota] noble nemesis.quest.7.230.1.8: With their magic, the sea bends to our will. Take your 28,000 gold—and keep yer eyes on the horizon.
The sea’s restless. Only 60 Water Elementals can calm her. Bring ’em to me, and we’ll make waves worth gold.
Still waitin’ on those Elementals—don’t let the tide slip away.
map.[hota] noble nemesis.quest.7.230.1.9: Now that’s what I call an upgrade! Here’s 25,000 gold for your trouble—the sea’s lookin’ better already.
The fisherman’s shack needs some serious sprucin’ up. Bring 5 wood, 20 mercury, 5 ore, 5 sulfur, 20 crystals, and 20 gems—let’s turn this place into a legend.
Don’t keep me waitin’—the sea’s watchin’, and so am I.
map.[hota] noble nemesis.quest.7.230.1.c: Not bad, eh? Fancy castin’ a line together to see what else we can catch?
map.[hota] noble nemesis.quest.7.230.1.f: Name’s Old Finn, best fisherman ’round these parts. Got a feel for finding treasures beneath the waves.
map.[hota] noble nemesis.quest.7.230.1.n: Name’s Old Finn, best fisherman ’round these parts. Got a feel for finding treasures beneath the waves.
As the scroll’s magic takes hold, the ancient stone trembles, crumbles, and fades into dust.
This ancient stone has stood here for centuries. Only magic could undo its hold on this land.
This ancient stone has stood here for centuries. Only magic could undo its hold on this land.

map.[hota] noble nemesis.quest.83.82.0.c: Ufretin is defeated! The dwarven mine is free, and the 30,000 gold bounty is yours.
map.[hota] noble nemesis.quest.83.82.0.f: The dwarven mine trembles under the heel of Ufretin, its stubborn keeper. His head carries a bounty of 30,000 gold. Brave the cave and claim your reward.
map.[hota] noble nemesis.quest.83.82.0.n: Ufretin still guards the mine in the northeast cave. The 30,000 gold bounty remains unclaimed.

There are seven boar glens in this area. These gorgons won’t eat themselves, you know. Fetch me some boars from the forest—think you can handle it?

map.[hota] noble nemesis.quest.97.25.1.c: Ufretin has fallen! His key turns in the lock—the gate swings wide open.
map.[hota] noble nemesis.quest.97.25.1.f: The gate is sealed. Only Ufretin, the mine ruler, carries the key. Defeat him, and the way shall open.
map.[hota] noble nemesis.quest.97.25.1.n: Ufretin still guards the mine. The key is not yet yours.
map.[hota] noble nemesis.sign.12.184.1.m: Ahoy! D’loot be hid ‘neath da Wasteland Shrine o’ da Magic Gesture—dig fast, ye scallywag!
map.[hota] noble nemesis.sign.190.97.0.m: The sign is all caked in volcanic dust. It reads: "Dragon Lair—Open Mon-Sun, 9 AM-5 PM"
