map.[hota] paradise lost.header.descript: Once upon a time, there was a magical city in this beautiful valley. However, a terrible cataclysm made it disappear under the water. After the disaster, many people tried to locate it and understand what caused the calamity, but their efforts were in vain. But surely you will succeed, won't you?
map.[hota] paradise lost.header.name: Paradise Lost
map.[hota] paradise lost.sign.63.33.0.me: I keep ancient knowledge in my head, but not everyone will be able to make use of it.
This realm is shrouded in mystery. It is said that all who try to claim it their own are slowly befallen by a curse that warps their sense of dream and reality, leaving them to wonder if they are awake or yet asleep.

You, too, have fallen victim to this strange affliction. Even now you are not sure if you are truly conscious or caught inside a lifelike dream.
Your first scout returns, having met a travelling bard with a penchant for gossip.

If the bard's tales are to be trusted, then you are not the first to explore this realm's secrets. Months past, two Erathian knights sought to to break the dream-curse at Her Majesty's request. However, they vanished soon after. What became of them is a mystery.
More recently, the Wizard King sent forth his cronies to study the dream-curse. It is not known if he seeks to destroy it or gain control over its powers. In any case, you should prepare to face these wizards in battle as they don't take kindly to strangers.

Lastly, various warlords have set up camp nearby. You will have to fight them too, lest you intend to share the spoils of war.
At nightfall your second scout returns, having found an old scholar who lives in a nearby cave. Once he heard of your plan to break the curse, the scholar was eager to share his findings.

According to him, the dream-curse first took hold roughly two years ago. Its origin is a matter of dispute, though many suspect foul magic.
The scholar theorized that the curse's dark power is fueled by the chaos, spite and bloodshed which have reigned supreme ever since the first warlords had lain claim to the realm. 

Thus ending the war yields the key to breaking the curse: when the realm is at peace, your mind will be too.
If this is true, then your path is clear: unite the realm under your banner and the dividing line between dream and reality will manifest again. Until then you must remain vigilant.

At daybreak you return to your war council with renewed vigor. Much is at stake, and the battle is far from over...
You task your two best scouts with finding the seers and scholars who dwell within these hills and caves. Perhaps they know more about the curse's dark design and, ideally, a way to break it.

In the meantime you should resume your conquest. Adventure awaits!
map.[hota] paradise of the mind.guards.1: Wrought of fine steel and engraved with gilded Bracadan runes that read "Ignis Aeterna", this Pandora's Box appears to be of great arcane value.

Thorned, jagged and speckled with dried blood, it is not difficult to tell that this Pandora's Box harbors a deadly menace. Your crewmates, fearing the worst, urge you to cast the box back into the sea.
Merely holding this Pandora's Box fills you with a sense of dread. When you run your thumb over its lid, your pulse quickens like the beating of a drum. A near unfathomable evil dwells within.
map.[hota] paradise of the mind.guards.4: This Pandora's Box bears the shamanic runes of a bygone ocean tribe. Although you fail to decipher them, you surmise that the box may be a reliquary of sorts.
map.[hota] paradise of the mind.guards.5: This Pandora's Box has no markings, no filigree, no gems or fancy metalwork. It appears well made, but at the same time so quaint that it is a challenge to judge.
map.[hota] paradise of the mind.header.d: This world is lush and bountiful, but all who tread its ground suffer from vivid dreams that fester in the mind. As time passes, the line between waking and sleeping blurs. You must find a cure for this strange affliction, and destroy all who stand in your way.
map.[hota] paradise of the mind.header.r: We live inside a dream, but who is the dreamer?
All that we see or seem is but a dream within a dream.
To gain the Summon Ship spell, sail to the heart of the sea.
In the Demon Wars many heroes left to join the Conflux. I wonder, did they ever return?
It is said that Zilare left on a journey in search for an old friend.
map.[hota] paradise of the mind.heroes.1: With Kreelah lain to waste, Adran returned to his slumber in the mountains near Eofol. However, the chaos of war had left him feeling restless. He soon rose up once more in search for new battles.
Alcyon's love for the aerial realm drew the eye of the Conflux, who called for him at the height of the Demon War. Alcyon left his old life behind, never to return.

The duke's return is shrouded in mystery. Some say that he had simply faked his death in order to evade Kilgor's wrath, while others whisper of foul magic, perhaps even Necromancy. Wheresoever the truth lies, Boragus is back and eager to prove his worth.
Robert "the Solitaire" is a lone wolf at heart, preferring the calm of the sea over the bustle of the pirate covens. A lifelong bachelor, he has dozens of nieces and nephews through his ten brothers.
Zilare had long sought a way to revert the effects of mind-altering spellcraft. However, his latest attempt backfired, putting the entire realm under a curse instead.
map.[hota] paradise of the mind.heroes.3: Struck by a curse of mania, Cimbule forsake magic in favor of craftwork. He is often found in the workshops, puzzling the Gremlins with sketches of winged boats and fire-spitting staffs.
map.[hota] paradise of the mind.heroes.4: Trystan is well-known for his courage, ardor and tactical naivete. Eager to break this realm's curse, he marched forth with high confidence only to be captured in a roadside ambush.

A Genie of modest power, Corrodus is eager to rise above his station. For this purpose he pledged himself to the Genie he deemed the most powerful: Lord Cimbule of Bracada. Cimbule agreed to train Corrodus - out of goodwill, and a quiet sense of pride in his reputation.
map.[hota] paradise of the mind.heroes.7: Tyris favors an all-or-nothing approach to warfare, taking high risks in order to soar to victory. Usually this strategy pays off well for her, however, her latest maneuver ended in her defeat and capture.
map.[hota] paradise of the mind.quest.17: These 7 Mummies will help me greatly in my necromantic pursuits. In exchange for them, I will give you a powerful artifact: the Pendant of Downfall.

Tales have been told of a strange triangular crypt that has sprung up where nothing but sand lay before. It is the fabled Tomb of Curses, wherein dwell the Mummies. I want you to capture 7 of these Mummies and bring them to me. I have great interest in their powers.
Are you here to bring me the 7 Mummies I had asked you about? If not, then there is nothing I can do for you.
map.[hota] paradise of the mind.quest.20: Ah, the Bird of Perception and Ladybird of Luck! These statues will make a fine addition to my collection. In return for them, I will put a blessing of Attack upon you.

I am a collector of bird statues searching for two rare masterworks, the Bird of Perception and Ladybird of Luck. If the tavern hearsay is to be trusted then both of these statues have fallen into the hands of bandits. If you were to encounter these fiends on your travels, put them to the sword and return the birds to me for a handsome reward.
According to my sources, both statues must be somewhere nearby, albeit guarded by monsters. Be swift to recover them!
map.[hota] paradise of the mind.quest.23: Excellent! With the potion brewn from these 5 vials of Mercury I can continue on my quest for enlightenment with a sharp and healthy mind. In return I will teach you Advanced Wisdom.

So consumed have I been in my personal projects that I have neglected to collect vital ingredients for the potion I use to sharpen my mind. Without it, I will soon grow forgetful and my wisdom will be for nought. I will humbly reward any who bring me 5 vials of Mercury.
Be swift! Bring me 5 vials of Mercury, lest my wisdom fades from my mind...
map.[hota] paradise of the mind.quest.25: The Nighthawks have indeed heard of your many victories and would be honored to fight alongside you. They are ready to depart as soon as you give the word.

I speak on behalf of the Nighthawks, a mercenary group of highest repute. While they are aware of the ongoing battle, they will not join a side just yet. In order to gain their support you must first prove your worth.
Unlike most sellswords, the Nighthawks can not be bought but rather follow a strict code of honor: they only fight alongside those they deem worthy. Perhaps one day they will join you, but not yet.
map.[hota] paradise of the mind.quest.39: Most excellent! This Sea Serpent is an ideal specimen for my research. In exchange for it, I will pay you 15 Gems.

Lately I have been studying the plethora of lifeforms which inhabit these waters. My work is almost complete, however, I still need to conduct various tests on the local Sea Serpents. If you were to find and capture one Sea Serpent, I will pay you its weight in gemstones.
It is said that Sea Serpents are descended from Azure Dragons and, like their ancestors, they are hostile to outsiders and near impossible to tame. Beware of their venomous bite!
map.[hota] paradise of the mind.quest.68: I have heard of Velour's defeat. If this is true, then you have freed the world from a great evil. Let me reward you by summoning 3 Magic Elementals.

Many years ago I fell into wickedness and was swept up in the mad ambitions of the vampire lord Velour. But I found heaven's grace in my deepest despair, and now I seek absolution. Velour must be destroyed, lest others follow his dark path.
Lord Velour was last seen on an island off the western coast. I wish I could to come with you, but even now I fear the vampire's dark power. I can only pray for you.
map.[hota] paradise of the mind.quest.69: Ah, this Tunic of the Cyclops is exactly what I have been looking for. If you were so kind to give it to me, I will return the favor by teaching you Expert Earth Magic.

Many generations ago this land was the battleground of warring Cyclops tribes. Their history has been lost to time, but what little is left of their smithwork is highly sought after amongst the Barbarians, who deem it enchanted by ancient magic. I wish to study this enchantment myself. Bring me the Tunic of the Cyclops King and I will reward you handsomely.
The Tunic of the Cyclops King is still out there, waiting to be found. If you do find it, bring it to me and I will teach you in the ways of Earth Magic.
map.[hota] paradise of the mind.quest.70: I see that you have achieved true balance of body and mind. Allow me to aid you in your quest for ultimate power.

Others may speak of the sanctity of the mind. However, the mind is no more sacred than the body, and true power requires a balance of skill: the mind's connection to the hand which wields the sword. Understand this and greater power is yours to unlock.
To align body and mind is but the first of many steps. Return to me when you are ready, and I will show you the way to great power.
map.[hota] paradise of the mind.quest.72: At last the Stoic Watchman returns to its rightful place! In exchange for it, I am willing to pay you a finder's fee of 3000 Gold. Do we have a deal?

While traversing the lands I was waylaid by bandits via guile and other chicanery. I lost many riches, the Stoic Watchman being the most valuable of them. I am offering a hefty sum of coin for its return.
The Stoic Watchman is of great historic value, as it once belonged to the Order of the Avian Sight. If you were to find it, please return it to me.
map.[hota] paradise of the mind.quest.86: At last, the fiends lie slain and the Warehouse of Gold is safe again. For your bravery, I will grant you 36 Spell Points.
Unfortunate news has arrived that the local Warehouse of Gold is besieged by vile fiends who hunger for the contents of its vaults. I urge you to slay these would-be thieves before they get away.
Any with the ability to save the Warehouse of Gold from its attackers will be rewarded with a boon of Spell Points. Be swift and bring me their heads!
map.[hota] paradise of the mind.quest.87: Tales have been told of the bandit camp lying in ruin. At last our woods are safe once more! Here is the promised reward: the Armor of Wonder.

Turmoil has engulfed the eastern woodlands. In the shadows of the trees, muggers and miscreants lie in wait to profit from lone wanderers. I offer the Armor of Wonder for any brave soul that can best these brigands.
Sadly, our woods are still plagued by bandits. I offer the Armor of Wonder for any who brings me their heads.
map.[hota] paradise of the mind.quest.99: With the beast slain, Tobren's soul shall find peace at last. You have done me a great service. Allow me to return the favor by imparting my wisdom to you.

I charge all those with knowledge of arms and armor to brave the dangers of the underworld to find the monster that killed my colleague, the Watermage Tobren Rainshield. Avenge Tobren's death by putting the monster and all its familiars to the sword. Justice must be served!
I must once again urge you to confront the monster that killed and mauled my friend. Until justice is served, I shall help you no further.
map.[hota] paradise of the mind.sign.103:
And as imagination bodies forth,
The forms of things unknown,
The poet's pen turns them to shapes.
I do not love the sword for its sharpness,
Nor the arrow for its swiftness,
Nor the warrior for his glory.
I love only what they defend.
Blithe dreams arise to greet us, 
and life feels clean and new, 
For the old love comes to meet us 
in the dawning and the dew.
Temple of Water

Caution: Wet floor
Shamrock Tavern

"May your troubles be less,
And your blessings be more.!"
map.[hota] paradise of the mind.sign.5.7:
May the winds of fortune sail you,
May you sail a gentle sea.
May it always be the other guy
who says, "this drink's on me!"
Sound trumpets,
Let our bloody colours wave!
And either victory,
Or else a grave.
The earth, and every common sight,
To me did seem
Apparelled in celestial light,
The glory and the freshness of a dream.
Wilfrey's Workshop

Caution: Golem guards on duty

Wing Tail Tavern

:: Today's menu ::
Crunchy critters in fungus soup
Lizard on a stick
Mysterious pie (eat at own risk)
Hold fast to dreams, 
for if dreams die, 
life is a broken-winged bird 
that cannot fly.
If we shadows have offended,
Think but this, and all is mended,
That you have but slumbered here
While these visions did appear.
map.[hota] perfect equality.header.descr: The plot is as old as the world – a dying king told four sons to find a worthy successor in a fair fight. The kingdom is great, and the king was able to give a fair piece of land to every son, so that there would be no unfair advantage.
map.[hota] perfect equality.header.name: Perfect Equality
The old man looks excited and proud of you. He grants you his knowledge.

You come to a small dwelling, built directly within an old but still quite mighty tree. In the bottom window a dim light was burning – apparently a candlestick was the only way to illuminate the house. While you were gathering your thoughts whether to come and knock on the door or not, it opened by itself and an old man stepped outside.

An old warrior lives here. He will be ready to teach you some tricks, but you must be worthy. Return when you have at least 32 attack and 14 defense.
The old man refuses to speak until you are strong enough.
You are potent enough, and the mage grants you some of his power.
You notice a small house on the outskirts of the forest. You decide to check what’s inside. You meet a mage, who is willing to grant you great power for 32 power and 14 knowledge.
You try to open the door again, but you see the 32 and 14 numbers appearing on it. You walk away.
You are approaching the house, knowing that you are ready. Inside, a man welcomes you. He offers his powers to train you in the arts of defense.

A few steps from the house, an arrow hits the ground under your legs.

"Protection - 32 points and attack - 14 points. Don’t dare to come closer without these stats."
You avoid the small house, as you know you are not yet prepared.
You come in the library, and are finally able to understand what the books are about. You learn a lot in your short time here.

You enter a small house, which appears to be a library. You randomly take a book from the shelf, but fail to understand the strange writings in it. Perhaps, possession of 32 knowledge and 14 power will grant you the knowledge of these pages.
You know that at the current time the library is a waste of time. You need more knowledge and power.
map.[hota] pirate's utopia.guards.12.138: A legendary ice palace is directly above you. Centuries ago, there lived a prince who rejected the love of the Goddess of Winter, and for that she turned him and all his possessions into dead ice. Prince can be released by those who are brave enough and smart.
map.[hota] pirate's utopia.guards.13.134: Once you're close to the ice palace, ice blocks, which must have pinned down the palace for centuries, began to melt...
map.[hota] pirate's utopia.guards.143.14: You want some of this? Come and get it.
map.[hota] pirate's utopia.guards.40.143: Your crew is seriously thinking about mutiny.
map.[hota] pirate's utopia.guards.60.114: This place drains the magical energy.
map.[hota] pirate's utopia.header.descri: The treasure of the legendary pirate queen is buried on an island. Search for it!
map.[hota] pirate's utopia.header.name: Pirate's Utopia
I've heard that there are a lot of hermits on the islands that are bored without civilization.
Had you known about a beautiful legend telling the Winter's love to an unknown prince? They say that he is imprisoned far to the south at the kingdom of ancient ice.
map.[hota] pirate's utopia.heroes.147.bi: Once a captive of the Goddess of Winter. Now set free by a brave hero.
What would you say, my lord?
Do you want to hire a group of evil-looking, but kind-hearted rogues?
The way to the plane of air is closed. Perhaps you may find it.
The growl and clanking of armor echoed through the cave. Nixes must have been camped nearby in the underground labyrinths.
map.[hota] province.event.0.description: These scarce lands are ravaged by war, and will not allow you to keep a large army. It is better to wait for your opponents to weaken each other, and then take a chance at delivering a final blow.
map.[hota] province.header.description: Scarce on resources, a small province was knee-deep at war between four lords. The land is barren and has no value to it, however not a single side will step back. It is a matter of principle now probably.
map.[hota] province.header.name: Province
Remember: whoever owns the sea owns all. Whoever owns the Horn of the Abyss also owns the sea. Now here's a paradox: to claim the Horn of the Abyss, you will first have to conquer the elements!
map.[hota] sails and propellers.header.d: In search of the legendary Horn of the Abyss, you will have to conquer land, sea and air. Harder still should it prove to conquer three other lords who cherish the same dream.
map.[hota] scorched earth.event.0.descri:
The once fertile land lies in ruins. Mines collapsed after an eruption on the island. Our only hope lies in the warehouses. The goods accumulated there will help to recover our strength.
The trouble, as always, does not come alone: what was not destroyed by lava, was pillaged by pirates and vultures. Besides, the lord you struggled with for years decided to strike at your weakened army, hoping to seize the entire island. Negotiation is not an option. You must prepare for the battle.
map.[hota] scorched earth.event.1.descri: Surviving workers were able to somewhat clear up the rubble. Some of the extracted resources were recovered.
map.[hota] scorched earth.event.2.descri: Remaining money was spent on paying thieves to man your distant garrison. Perhaps they will save us the hassle of unexpected guests for some time.
map.[hota] scorched earth.event.3.descri: Rumor has it that some mines in the dungeons could have survived.
map.[hota] scorched earth.guards.35.34.0:
As if it was not enough for pirates to plunder the island, they have also taken over the remains of a village.

It’s not the best idea to set a camp near the erupting volcano, but these guys seem to care little.
map.[hota] scorched earth.header.descrip: An eruption of a volcano forces you to halt extraction of resources on the island. The mines collapsed, burned down or were flooded with boiling lava. The only remaining source of supplies is the warehouses. Apparently, a neighboring lord is keeping an eye on them as well.
map.[hota] scorched earth.header.name: Scorched Earth
map.[hota] scorched earth.sign.67.27.0.m: You fished a bottle out of the water, but you found nothing more than some excellent rum inside. This one's to the pirate who lost it!
map.[hota] seven days.event.0.descriptio: The couriers report: while Ziph was fighting the barbarian hordes, our neighbor Maghera started a war against us. Her troops are already attacking our borders. Our warriors will be able to hold off her offensive for a few days, but we need to hurry back to the castle before Maghera captures it!
map.[hota] seven days.event.1.descriptio: The courier arrived with news: Maghera has managed to penetrate our border fortifications and is only a day's march away from our castle!
map.[hota] seven days.guards.33.70.0.mes: Your warriors are encouraged and eager to move!
map.[hota] seven days.guards.67.7.0.mess: Army increase on Expert and Impossible
map.[hota] seven days.guards.70.7.0.mess: More money on Expert and Impossible
map.[hota] seven days.header.description: While you were away from home, your neighbour, the scheming dark elf Maghera, decided to take your lands. You must act quickly to gather your troops, build fortifications, and return home to fight the villain!
map.[hota] seven days.header.name: Seven Days
map.[hota] seven days.heroes.200.name: Maghera
map.[hota] seven days.monster.3.51.0.mes: The warriors still loyal to you want to join your army!
map.[hota] seven days.monster.71.44.0.me: The warriors still loyal to you want to join your army!
map.[hota] strait of storms - invasion.e: You became aware that Planeswalkers did not come alone. They hired orcs, goblins, and other foreigners, so that they do all the dirty work for them.
map.[hota] strait of storms - invasion.h: Precarious peace in the strait was broken by invasion of Elemental Lords. They have created a portal in the heart of the sea. And even though you have strengthened the approaches to the monolith, the enemy did not retreat.
map.[hota] strait of storms - skirmish.h: Strait of Storms is a strategically important point on this land. Supersede a competitor from the other side and get full control over the strait!
map.[hota] strife in the woods.event.0.d: For a while, you have been a part of an alliance between knights, elves, barbarians, artificers, pirates, and swamp dwellers. Recently, some arrogant wizards arrived, and they are already making your life muserable. Their intrigues have shattered the already fragile alliance, and now they are trying to extort money from you. You are fed up with this situation and are determined to wipe out both your former allies and the racketeering wizards.
map.[hota] strife in the woods.event.1.d: The wizards came to you and demanded gold, citing an alleged obligation once taken by your ancestor to pay for the use of magic. However, as soon as your guardsmen drew their swords, the wizards retreated towards the exit. Before they left, your men took everything they had on them, including the gold they had earlier coerced out of other lords. The money went into your own coffers.
map.[hota] strife in the woods.event.2.d:
The wizards returned, but this time they came protected by golems. Seems as though they are learning from their mistakes...

You had to yield some gold to them.
map.[hota] strife in the woods.header.de: The alliance between the lords was very unstable. The knights, barbarians, and swamp dwellers were all waiting for the moment to break the treaty and benefit as much as possible from this deed. When wizards settled in the hills, the balance was disrupted, and the alliance crumbled. Prepare to war!
map.[hota] talent shortage.event.0.descr: Mullich was even madder than usual. The fleeing soldiers took everything they could carry. There was no one left in the castle. Valets, stableboys, blacksmiths, the century-old housekeeper, just about everyone legged it. The only one to stay was David the squire, whom Mullich ordered to tie to a pole the day before after the guy stole a ham from the master pantry. The kid was in for a rotten string of days, as Mullich would definitely be taking it all out on him.
map.[hota] talent shortage.guards.1.35.0: Tribulations of the day gave Mullich some new knowledge.
Tribulations of the day gave Mullich some new knowledge.
Oh look, aren't these Mullich's former squad? It didn't take long for them to hit the skids without proper leadership, and it seems they're hopeful to recoup their losses out of their former commander.
Tribulations of the day gave Mullich some new knowledge.
Tribulations of the day gave Mullich some new knowledge.
Tribulations of the day gave Mullich some new knowledge.
map.[hota] talent shortage.guards.33.5.0: A charge of lightning made Mullich's hair stand up. He feels some new knowledge boiling under his skull.
In hindsight, it was silly to hope no one would jump out of a sea of flames like this one. Well, lo and behold.
Tribulations of the day gave Mullich some new knowledge.
map.[hota] talent shortage.guards.37.5.0: Tribulations of the day gave Mullich some new knowledge.
This shrine is guarded after all! To arms!!!
map.[hota] talent shortage.guards.46.2.0: Tribulations of the day gave Mullich some new knowledge.
Just as Mullich thought that was about enough Undead business for tonight...
A thief who Mullich caught feeling around his empty purse was forced to pledge himself to the knight's cause; the only other option was to be executed immediately.
map.[hota] talent shortage.guards.9.53.0: Oh, cute! These dragons are having a date here. Shame they really don't like attention.
map.[hota] talent shortage.header.descri: Sir Mullich's act got old. The morning after the infamous knight had another violent ourburst, he woke up to an empty castle. His people packed up and left in the thick of the night, just as Mullich was given a pest control mission in the royal countryhouse...
map.[hota] talent shortage.header.name: Talent Shortage
map.[hota] talent shortage.quest.10.44.0: Here's your new equipment, please sign here. This also means you're to report immediately if a crusade is launched.
Come join our refitting program! We offer lighter swords, sturdier armor and nicer buc... helmets!
We won't issue armament to some random scrub. Bring an experienced swordsman.
map.[hota] talent shortage.quest.11.52.0: Step right up, here's your new vestment. Just try to abstain from hurling bolts indoors, will you?
Fashionable blue cassocks and powered-up bolts! For distinguished clergy only.
map.[hota] talent shortage.quest.12.34.0: Did you get it all? Oh great, dump it all here! You must be exhausted to carry such a pile of surplus gear.
We can take useless scrap off your hands. Well, you might call it useless, but we hope to repurpose it nicely Here's what we're after.
A helmet, a shield, a breastplate, and a sash. Would you like me to write you a list?
map.[hota] talent shortage.quest.15.33.1: At last! Here, take my bow and my armor, and get that prince bastard an arrow in the belly for me if you ever happen to meet him!
I was banished into the underworld many years ago, after defeating the prince in an archery contest. I was really good, and I'd like to pass what remained of my talent onto a younger elf.
Hurry up, bring me an elf! I'm not going to last forever!
map.[hota] talent shortage.quest.17.26.0: Shall we get on with the retraining?
Gee, you finally decided to give your men something more impressive than sticks and hatchets? You've come to the right place then...
Hand over the crystals, and begone. I myself am getting tired of slacking here.
Admittance will set you back 10 crystals, no less.
You don't have 10 crystals to spare? For shame! And you dare call yourself a knight!
Ready to get your hands dirty, kid?
If you want to up your shooting rate, you'll have to put in twice as much work...
I hope your elf doesn't mind partaking in my experiment. Thing is... it has a rather unusual side-effect.

I believe I've found a way to bless men who don't have innate magical abilities. I want to carry out and experiment, but I'm afraid I'm lacking a suitable subject. Do you happen to have an elf to spare? I won't break him, I promise!
An elf! I need an elf!
I heard from a wise man that a certain drawstring, severed from its bow, helps you shoot way better!
map.[hota] talent shortage.quest.34.60.0: Here's our girl! Are you ready to get promoted?
Are you wondering how our tree stands unscathed in a sea of flames? Well, we're masters of the element of water, and fire can't touch us. Would you like to learn this trick? Then bring us a witch.
Only a witch can master our complicated magicks.
map.[hota] talent shortage.quest.35.32.1: Would you like to learn to march fast?
You can learn to march double time here.
You can learn to march double time here. Choose wisely!
map.[hota] talent shortage.quest.36.28.1: Would you like to learn to shoot well?
You can learn to shoot with great accuracy here.
You can learn to shoot with great accuracy here. Choose wisely!
map.[hota] talent shortage.quest.40.45.0: Oh, bless you! My collection is complete now! Would you like to pass?
I'm a collector interested in rarities crafted in the "graveyard Empire" style. I heard there are several things like that to be found in around these parts. Would you mind bringing them to me?
Skulls, bones, decay and despair. That's what I'm looking for.
map.[hota] talent shortage.quest.44.22.0: Hey, it's me again. I'll take 10 gems this time.
You don't have 10 gems to spare? For shame! And you dare call yourself a knight!
Here it is! Shall we trade?
A Centaur's Axe? What do you need this hunk of iron for? Hand it over, and I'll give you something nice in return.
It's an axe. Big and rather unwieldy. Get it to me.
map.[hota] talent shortage.quest.45.44.0: Here's a nice cassock for our new brother!
We are a militant order. Would your crusader be interested to join?
Is there no one willing to take the monastic path?
map.[hota] talent shortage.quest.51.10.0: Shall we start our sword practice?
Your shooters may convert into heavy infantry here.
No shooters in your army? What kind of an army it even is?!
Did you know your rogue was an elf? We'll set him up with a bow, he'll do good with it.
We help former reprobates reform and find a righteous path in life. If you encounter one, bring him here.
map.[hota] talent shortage.quest.59.16.0: Hand over the ring, and I'll give your guys a nice drill.
Would you like to know the secret to be naturally sturdy? You won't even need this ring anymore, which I'm going to claim as my payment...
Ring of Vitality. It's a pretty gold trinket. Carry on with your search.
You may learn to shoot well or to march fast here, but not both.
map.[hota] taming of the shrew.event.2.d:
Princess Cait "the Shrew" has vanished. Hell-bent on dodging the confines of wedlock, she has forged a pact with the pirates and dragon lords and fled to their lairs of evil.

At this point, only a fool would go after her... if it weren't for her family's vast fortune.
map.[hota] taming of the shrew.event.3.d:
Indeed, you're not the only suitor. Three others seek to put Cait's allies to the sword, a daring quest that will surely win her heart.

This leaves you caught between rivals, pirates and dragons. You'll have to beat them all, so you better get to it!
map.[hota] taming of the shrew.header.de: Princess Cait is mean, foul-mouthed... and heir to a vast fortune, which is why you set your eyes on her. To win her heart, you must beat her and her pirate friends in battle.
map.[hota] taming of the shrew.header.ru: Princess Cait has many suitors. Most of them die.
The night Cait vanished, a winged beast was seen circling her tower.
The Nighon lords are in uproar: the Vial of Dragon Blood was stolen from their vault.
Love is blind. Or so they say...
To find the heart of Cait's forces, enter the Moon Cavern and pass the Black Gate.
He rarely talks about it, but the owner of Sentinel Tavern used to be a famous knight.
Ever played chess? In this map, the Rook seizes castles, while the Bishop finds relics.
map.[hota] taming of the shrew.heroes.15: To fight off her suitors, Cait drank the Vial of Dragon Blood which turned her into a mighty dragon.

Although he is the namesake of a fabled knight, this pirate is of far more ill repute. The Regnans call him "Cannonball" as wherever he goes, chaos and bedlam follow. Despite his boorish ways, he is said to be fiercely loyal to his friends.
map.[hota] taming of the shrew.heroes.16: Teej is a young slaver whose thirst for blood is only matched by his hunger for gold. In return for her father's riches, he provided Cait the Shrew with the fabled Vial of Dragon Blood.
map.[hota] taming of the shrew.heroes.27: Gem was one of the greatest Sorceresses that Enroth had ever seen, serving King Roland Ironfist during the Succession Wars.  Shortly after Roland had secured the throne of Enroth, Gem left for Antagarich.
In days long past, Michael shared a deep bond with the knight Tamika. When Tamika was bitten by a Vampire, Michael devoted his life to battling the dark forces that took her from him. He has since become an accomplished Vampire hunter, although he dreads the day he will face Tamika in battle.
map.[hota] taming of the shrew.quest.1.6: Is that... the Pendant of Death! I must have it. Hand it over and my relic is yours!
So, you've come to claim this treasure? Let me offer you a fair trade - one artifact for another. I'll give you my relic in exchange for the Pendant of Death.
Surely you agree that the Pendant of Death is a fair price for my relic? Return to me once you've found it. I heard it was last seen inside a Crypt far east of here.
Excellent! With these 3 Gold Golems, my vault will be safe from intruders. 

As promised, I'll pay you 10 Crystal for them.

Below this hut lies my Crystal vault: a treasury of the rarest and most brilliant Crystals you'd ever see. A vault like that shouldn't be left unguarded, so I'm in need for strong and sturdy monsters.

Gold Golems are said to be well-suited for such a task. Bring me 3 of them and I'll reward you with 10 Crystals.

There are two Golems Factories in the far-north and far-east tunnels. As far as I know, they're only places where one can forge Gold Golems. 

I'd offer a hefty sum of 10 Crystal for 3 of them!
map.[hota] taming of the shrew.quest.103:
Ah, these 15 Halflings will be of great help in the harvest. 

In exchange for their service, I will pay you 4000 Gold. Do we have a deal?

The harvest is bountiful this year. I could use a helping hand on the fields - many hands, in fact. 

If you bring me 15 Halfling workers, I will pay you with a fair share of my earnings: 4000 Gold.

This year's harvest is coming along nicely, but it'd be easier with a few extra workers. 

If you meet any Halflings on your travels, 15 to be precise, send them my way and I'll pay you 4000 Gold.
map.[hota] taming of the shrew.quest.107: For 10 Ore, I'll teach you Advanced Scholar. Do we have a deal?

The benefit of living in a tree house is that you never run out of firewood. Ore, on the other hand, is hard to come by. 

Bring me 10 Ore and I'll give you a lesson in Scholar.
You seem to be short on Ore, just like me. Come back when you have 10 Ore.
You're who I've been looking for - a hero strong enough to carry my Dragon Scale Shield. Good luck, and fight well!

I used to be a great warrior. But now my fighting days are over, and I'm looking for someone to bestow my Dragon Scale Shield to. 

At least 10 Defense are required to wield it.

I'm still searching for a suitable heir to my Dragon Scale Shield, a strong and sturdy hero with no less than 10 Defense. 

One day, I might even give it to you!
I see that you have lain the foundation of true greatness. It's time for the next step. 

Hear my wisdom, hero, and ascend...!

In this world, all things go step by step. To grow a garden, you must first plant its seeds. To build a temple, you must first lay its foundation. To be better, you must first be good. 

Come to me when you've grown strong, and I will help you grow even stronger.
Be patient. You are not ready to learn my wisdom, but soon you will be.
At last the Arena is saved! I can't wait to return.

But before I go, let me teach you Basic Offense.

I used to be a Gladiator at the Arena, but then monsters attacked - even I couldn't beat them! Now I sit here and sulk in my misery.

If you can do what I couldn't, come find me after the battle.
The Arena is south of here. If you beat the monsters, I'll teach you Basic Offense. Good luck and fight well!
Since I live so far from home, I've mastered the Teleport spell to visit my family. I hope you'll make good use of it too! 

Are you ready to hand over the 7 Mercury?

Oh, a visitor! I don't get those very often. 

Since you've made the effort to come all the way out here, let me make you a special offer: I'll teach you the Teleport spell for 7 Mercury.
Hello again! I'm ready to teach you the Teleport spell as soon as you have 7 Mercury for me.
map.[hota] taming of the shrew.quest.4.1:
These 14 Troglodytes will help me get closer to a cure for Blindness. You've done a good deed today!

As a reward, I can teach you all I know about Blindness.

I'm a doctor who seeks to restore eyesight to the blind. A lofty goal, but as the saying goes, "Shoot for the stars"!

To start things off, I'll have to study the Blindness of the Troglodytes. Bring me 14 and I'll share my findings with you.

I've heard of a Dungeon in the southern wastes. That's where the Troglodytes live.

Bring me 14 Troglodytes so I can begin my studies on their Blind affliction.
Hm, you seem like you can handle your finances. 

I'm sure you'll put this 4000 Gold to good use. Off you go then!

While exploring the mountains, I found a cache of 4000 Gold.

I'll only give it to someone I can trust not to waste it. Smart financing takes Experience - do you have it?
I'll hold onto my 4000 Gold for now. You don't seem capable enough to put it to good use. Earn more Experience and come back when you're done!
Finally, 2 Sea Serpents! I'll make you a plate of Sea Serpent Stew right away - it's on the house! 

Oh, and if that's not enough, here's the Sentinel's Shield.

Greetings! I'm the tavern cook. I need your help in a culinary matter.

I used to make my world-famous Sea Serpent Stew for the tavern patrons. However, I've run out of the main ingredient: Sea Serpent! 

I need at least 2 of them to get my kitchen running again. In return, I'll give you my old shield.

A cook without his trademark dish is like a knight without his sword...!

Hopefully I'll find 2 Sea Serpents soon, or I'll have to sell my belongings in order to make ends meet, including my old shield...
For the Dragon Wing Tabard, I'll give you the Necklace of Dragonteeth. Do we have a deal?

Welcome to the Dragon Shop! I trade in draconic artifacts.

If you bring me the Dragon Wing Tabard, I'll give you the Necklace of Dragonteeth. A fair trade, I'm sure!

Still looking for the Dragon Wing Tabard? It could be anywhere... Maybe even all the way south!

If you find it, I'm willing to trade it for the Necklace of Dragonteeth.
map.[hota] taming of the shrew.quest.5.6:
Wonderful! If you're willing to part with these 9 Crew Mates, I can see about setting sail - finally! 

In exchange for them, you can have my Necklace of Ocean Guidance.

I've always dreamt of a mariner's life. To sail the Seven Seas, explore the world, and sing shanties in the night... 

I already have a ship, all I need is a crew! 9 Crew Mates should suffice.

Life is dull. I wish I were an adventurer like you! But first I need some hearty souls to man my ship.

If you bring me 9 Crew Mates, I'll return the favor by giving you my old Necklace of Ocean Guidance.
As promised, here's 1 Azure Dragon for your 1 Gold Dragon and 1 Titan. Are you ready to trade?

I'm a collector of rare monsters. Are you interested in a trade?

In exchange for 1 Gold Dragon and 1 Titan, I'll give you 1 Azure Dragon.
Still interested in trading with me? Bring me 1 Gold Dragon and 1 Titan, and I'll give you 1 Azure Dragon.
With these Cards of Prophecy, we can read your fortune. Let's see...

Hm, it appears that you're destined to win this war! In that case, we'd be honored to join you!
Me and my sisters have the gift of fortune telling. If you bring us the Cards of Prophecy, we can use them to read your fortune.

Anybody's future is written in the stars. 

If you bring us the Cards of Prophecy, we tell you what the stars say about you!

You must be the hero the Angel told me about. 

Here, take this Helm of Heavenly Enlightenment.

An Angel bestowed this Helm of Heavenly Enlightenment to me and tasked me with keeping it safe until a worthy hero arises.

Are you a master of all four Primary skills?

Only the best of the best may have the Helm of Heavenly Enlightenment.

Return to me when you've mastered all four Primary skills.
I see that you're a talented battle mage. In that case, I'll teach you the Inferno spell. Make good use of it!

I'm a master of Fire Magic. "The God of Inferno" is what they called me in my fighting days.

I'll teach you a powerful spell, if you're strong enough to learn it.
My fire spell is not suited for a novice mage - you'd just set yourself on fire!
These 10 Wood will help me a lot!

In return, I'll give you some of my livestock: 18 Boars.
It's getting cold, isn't it? I should probably build a stable for my pigs so they'll make it through the winter. Would you be so kind to bring me 10 Wood?
Hello again! I'm busy prepping my farm for the coming winter days, but it'd be much easier if I had more material - 10 Wood to be precise.

The Crystal Cavern is running again? That's great news! You have my thanks.

If my gratitude isn't enough, how about I teach you Basic Estates?

My Crystal Cavern was taken over by monsters. I'm too weak to fight them myself, so all I can do is sit here and sulk.

Can you help me out? The Crystal Cavern lies past the northern gate. In return, I'll teach you Estates.

Last I heard, the Crystal Cavern is still beset by monsters.

It's right past the northern gate, just in case you feel like helping me out!
For the shockingly low price of 4000 Gold, the Chain Lightning spell will be yours!

Welcome to my Spell Shop! 

I sense that your spell book leaves much to be desired. If you're looking for something more... electrifying, one of my Air Spells might give your system just the shock it needs. 

It only costs 4000 Gold!

You don't have 4000 Gold? I am shocked! 

Return to me with a full purse and I'll teach you the Chain Lightning spell.

Just don't wait too long - I'm only going to sell this spell once!
I see that you're a true believer of Knowledge. I'd be honored to join you. Shall we go?
"Knowledge is power." Many have said this, but few truly mean it. What about you?

I'll only join someone who knows the true power of Knowledge. 

If that someone even exists...!
The Badge of Courage! With this I'll succeed for sure! 

I'll be off to speak to the Mermaid now, but before I go, let me raise your Defense skill by 2 Points. 

Oh, and you're invited to the wedding!

Have you seen the Mermaid who lives in this bay? She's a beauty, isn't she? I've been meaning to speak to her, but I can't muster up the courage to do so. 

Maybe the Badge of Courage will help me...

Talking to a Mermaid is harder than I've imagined. 

If only I had the Badge of Courage to lift my spirits...!
You've got the look of someone who's travelled far and seen a lot. Was it a good journey? I hope so!

Here's a gift to make things a bit easier: the Boots of Speed.

I'm a big believer in the virtue of patience. As the saying goes, "Good things come to those who wait." 

Return to me once you've progressed a fair amount into your journey and I'll bestow a gift to you.

I'll help you at an appointed time. That time has not yet come! 

Return to me when you have more Experience.
Ah, you're the ideal subject for my arcane experiment. If my calculations are correct then it's going to raise your Spell Power by 2 points. 

Hold still - this might sting a little...

Through research of the arcane I found a way to infuse a person with raw mana, raising their Spell Power by 2 points. However, I still need to do some testing - on a test subject, that is. 

I seek a hero strong enough to withstand the full power of an arcane flux. They must be at least Level 8.
Guinea pigs are hard to come by these days. I've searched far and wide for a suitable test subject for my Spell Power experiment, but I just can't find anyone...
Is that... the Amulet of the Undertaker! I must have it. Hand it over and my relic is yours!
So, you've come to claim this treasure? Let me offer you a fair trade - one artifact for another. I'll give you my relic in exchange for the Amulet of the Undertaker.
Surely you agree that the Amulet of the Undertaker is a fair price for my relic? Return to me once you've found it. I heard it was last seen inside a Crypt far west of here.
Now here's a warrior if I've ever seen one! I'd be honored to train you.
These days, heroes of true grit are a rarity. What about you? Does your Attack skill instill fear in the hearts of your enemies?
The heroes of the modern age are all pansies! I'm not going to waste my time with training them.
: Hexagon Heights :

North - Palm Tree Cave
West - Shipyard
East - Scholar's Hut
South - Labyrinth
Seated all on deck, we floated
Down the Rhine's majestic stream,

On its borders, summer-laden,
Slept the peaceful evening-gleam...
map.[hota] taming of the shrew.sign.14.3:

North - Beholder's Lake
West - Gem Pond
East - Dragon Fly Hive
South - Shipyard
map.[hota] taming of the shrew.sign.16.9:
: Fields of Summer :

North - Unicorn Glade
West - Saw Mill
East - Swordsman's Hut
South - Crystal Cavern
map.[hota] taming of the shrew.sign.18.7:
: Mount Xanadu :

North - Workshop
West - Golden Pavillon
East - Darkwater Cavern
South - Seafarer's Shrine
map.[hota] taming of the shrew.sign.23.3:
: Guide to Pandora's Box :

If it floats, don't open it -
Unless you're ready to die.
map.[hota] taming of the shrew.sign.35.7:
: Moon Cavern :

North - Black Gate
West - Nix Fort
East - Wineyard
South - Medusa Stores

The past few years have been relatively peaceful. Occasionally, you had to fight off attacks from pirates and savages, but there was little else to worry about. However, a few days ago, alarming news started coming from the south. First, a messenger arrived, reporting odd activity of lizardmen in the swamps. Then, a whole fleet of pirates arrived from the other side of the strait. Contrary to their habit, this time the pirates weren't interested in plundering coastal villages. They seemed to be fleeing in terror from something or someone. Several sea dogs got captured, but they were so scared you couldn't coerce any information out of them. Yesterday, a traveler from the southern lands visited you. He brought frightening news: a magical cataclysm had broken out in the land of wizards in the south. Now there are icy plains interspersed with patches of surviving vegetation where swamps used to be. The wanderer doesn't know why the wizards have done this, but one thing is clear: if they are not stopped now, the cataclysm will soon devour your pirate neighbors. And then, the storm of ice will reach you.

The scouts have discovered a town of the dead deep in the caves beneath our lands, ruled by a necromancer. The undead are not aggressive (at least they haven't appeared on the surface in years), but it's good that we know about this town now. Who knows when its dwellers may come in handy!

Something intriguing has come to light. It seems that in the realm of wizards, there is a portal leading to a place where magical energy is concentrated. Perhaps this is where they draw the power they need to maintain the magical anomalies.

Our scout, sent to the pirate lands a while ago, has returned with news. Some pirate sorcerers have recently returned to their fortress. It seems that they have been studying water magic in the distant lands of the hydromancers, and they have found a way to transport their troops across water without the use of ships!
For the past few months, the wizards have been closely observing our actions. Now it seems they intend to march their forces north and strike first. The question is whether we will be ready.

Faerie dragons are long-time allies of wizards.
Not so long ago, the wizards found a way to make golems of pure steel.
They say that only hydras and serpent flies survived the glaciation of the swamps.

map.[hota] the cursed legions.event.0.de: The rocky lands have served as a good home for troglodytes and harpies. Although many of your kind still remain in the caves, you've reclaimed most of the land. However, as luck would have it, a couple of problems have arisen. The first one is the necromancers. Their bony faces suddenly appeared near several dungeons, frightening many with their disgusting looks. There also hasn't been any word from the caves in a while, so it seems something has settled in there too. Fortunately, the second problem is a little easier: the demons. They are merciless and want to take your lands, aye; but it seems they have the same problems with necromancers as you do. You should try to reclaim the demon lands after taking back most of your dungeons. And, of course, drive away the necromancers. For now, it's best to dive into your stash and gather the resources you've been saving for a rainy day.
map.[hota] the cursed legions.event.1.de: You've been eyeing your neighbors' holdings for a long time. Warlocks have occupied the rocky lands, and their servants are living their best lives, even though they're more accustomed to dwelling in caves. You sense they're about to claim your necromancer-ridden territories and caves. Although, it seems the dead have pounced on them too. You need to hurry with three things: reclaim your fiery fortresses, thwart the warlocks' plans, and crush any undead that stand in your way. Fortunately, you have a small supply of resources, so you'll have fewer problems as you start.
map.[hota] the cursed legions.event.2.de: It seems the main undead force is in the caves. Perhaps it's worth sending a second commander there to check out the situation.
map.[hota] the cursed legions.event.3.de:
Your advisor recommends attempting to reach the sea, as rumors suggest there's an archipelago there with towns of the Erathian-Bracadian alliance. They're currently unclaimed, but a portal has appeared there, from which a necromancer scout may have already emerged. There's a chance we can claim the towns for ourselves and acquire archangels and titans... provided, of course, we have the funds.

Moreover, the threat of necromancers is causing refugees to flock to your main cities, meaning you have more recruits!
map.[hota] the cursed legions.event.5.de: A small convoy with resources has arrived!
map.[hota] the cursed legions.header.des: It all started suddenly. The rocky and volcanic lands were taken by necromancers, and some of the caves are overflowing with the dead. It seems there is no hope: the necromancers came in force and their skeletons are everywhere. However, armies from the main forts are eager to burn all in their path
map.[hota] the cursed legions.header.rum: The island in the middle was once whole, but because of the wizards' meddling, it split apart.

The old prophet told you about the legendary Horn of the Abyss. This immensely strong artifact could be a key for defeating evil monsters spawning across the world. To summon the artifact, one has to gather a huge army of fangarms and bring them to the mad wizard to conduct the ritual of summoning.
This land has served your kindgom well and will provide enough resources to expand your borders. The old prophet used to say: "Southern regions are rich, but also dangerous".
This land has served your kindgom well and will provide enough resources to expand your borders. The old prophet used to say: "Northern regions are rich, but also dangerous".
Old prophet tells you a story about the mythical island in the center of the world. Centuries ago it was an arena where gods lived. It's supposed to be filled with treasures.
The old prophet told you a story about an ancient passage that collapsed centuries ago. Rumors say that evil forces are building a portal to once again invade the world.
You heard a rumor that mages living on the central island found a way to revive a dead person. This cannot be right, right..?
Legions of hell are countless. Your scouts report that they have never seen so many demons coming out from hell.
There is an ancient shrine located on the central island. People say that runes located there can teach you how to teleport between different locations!

map.[hota] the great wasteland.header.de: Back in the day, these lands had been bustling with life and prospering, before an experiment of a mad alchemist gone awry made them a charred wasteland. The lords who survived the calamity aim to take over this place, odd-looking but still full of treasure. You must act now to beat them to it!
map.[hota] the great wasteland.monster.1: Get lost! This is our treasure!
map.[hota] the great wasteland.monster.3: May the Light guide you on your path!
map.[hota] the great wasteland.sign.18.6: Here lives a famous card magician, also a sorcerer and a conjurer!
map.[hota] the great wasteland.sign.49.1: Why would you even want this bottle? There's nothing in it. Well, since you're here anyway, let me tell you the Grail's in the underworld.
map.[hota] the great wasteland.sign.55.5: PROMOTION! On February 30, a 100% discount on ALL skills for all fools!!! Don't miss it!
map.[hota] treasures of the pyramid.even: You have arrived here on an archaeological expedition. Unfortunately, three of your competitors have also turned up in these parts: they also seem to want to profit from the treasures hidden in the pyramid. Whoever can not only retrieve the treasure first, but also build the Temple of the Grail, will win this race! However, there is another way: you could simply eliminate the competitors and assert your right to these lands. What will you choose?
Scorching desert sands and gloomy tunnels of the tombs are waiting for you!
Additional funding for your expedition has arrived.
Your sponsor doesn't seem to be doing very well. Your expedition's funding was halved.

Today you received a report: the fresh financing your company received from the employer is hardly more than pocket change. You seem to be on your own now. However, this means you won't have to share the treasure with anyone either!
Things aren't easy without external funding: reluctantly, you allocate money to solve the problems that have piled up over the past week.

map.[hota] treasures of the pyramid.head: The secrets hidden in the Great Pyramid of the Pharaohs are waiting! Cross the desert, venture into the underground halls and retrieve the great treasure lost in the scorching sands—that is, if you are unfazed by competition and tall tales about the Pharaohs' curse.
Treasures of the Pyramid
map.[hota] treasures of the pyramid.ques: Finally! Priceless evidence of the Pharaonic era! Give it to me, and keep the reward. I'll pay you more if you bring me another Pendant of Life.

I represent the Archaeologists' Guild. Our organization is very keen on the relics of bygone times. We are now looking for symbols of the power once wielded by the Pharaohs who built the Great Pyramid in this desert. If you happen to find the Ankh, or as it is called in these parts, the Pendant of Life, I will pay you handsomely. For each one you bring, that is!
Didn't find a single Pendant of Life? The Great Pyramid is still waiting for its explorers.

Finally! All the power of the Pharaohs, contained in this small trifle... In mine... In our hands. Do you feel the power rushing through our bodies? Bring me as many Pendants as you can find, and we will enjoy this wonderful feeling together, again and again.

The Pendants of Life... are keys. Keys to authority, power, and strength. Don't let my unsightly appearance scare you away; don't leave! Bring me a Pendant of Life so I can release the essence contained in it and share some of its hidden power with you.
The Pendant! Where is the Pendant of Life? You do not bear any... I can tell it by smell. Come back with the Pendant, and we will share the power it holds!

A covenant is a covenant. I will now release the energy of the Pendant: watch as your new allies emerge from their sarcophagi. But remember this: I will bring an unimaginable curse upon you and your entire kin if you make my warriors plunder and destroy!

Halt, you mortal! How dare you desecrate my master's tomb?.. Or maybe, you are not one of those who come to the pyramid, seeking only to destroy and plunder. Help me protect this abode of eternal afterlife. Bring me the Pendant of Life, brimming with power, and I will give you 50 exceptional mummy warriors. The more Pendants you can bring, the bigger will be the army waiting for you...
You... just like everyone else... you're a dirty little thief! Prove me wrong: bring me the Pendant of Life! Protect the tomb!

map.[hota] trial of flame.event.0.descri:
My name is Manfred, I'm one of the best fire mages. At least, I try to be. I come from nomadic people who have never had a home. I had to leave my tribe to learn magic.

However, the legends of my people tell of the legendary Desert Fire, where no soldier dared to go. There, the earth itself breathes with heat and fiery creatures seep through the fabric of space in our world. If I can conquer the fiery desert, I will gain expertise of fire magic. But if I hesitate, the land will kill me with its breath. By my calculations, I can survive in this hell for no longer than two months.
map.[hota] trial of flame.event.1.descri:
Today I met the first living person in this desert. A nomad as he told me, talked about an old goblin settlement. It is located in the east near the oasis.
Great news!
map.[hota] trial of flame.event.2.descri:
This is the place... Scorching sun, sand... Heat is everywhere.
I will not last long here, it is necessary to find suitable shelter with shade...
map.[hota] trial of flame.event.3.descri: The main challenge for me is to conquer the desert. Apparently, the creatures from the Plane of Fire cause strong perturbations of space. I have to destroy them or subdue their will. The space will calm down and the energy flow will normalize.
map.[hota] trial of flame.event.4.descri: I realized that in this hell we need to save not only water, but also people. Not that many brave souls dare to enter these lands.
map.[hota] trial of flame.event.5.descri: I must hurry. Every day it becomes more and more difficult for me to protect the body from the withers.
map.[hota] trial of flame.event.6.descri: This morning I was bleeding from the nose and eyes become less sharp, everything is blurred. We must hurry, my powers are nearly depleted.
map.[hota] trial of flame.header.descrip: Manfred, a beginner magician is about to pass his first test – the trial of flame. Explore the harsh and unpredictable desert and destroy its inhabitants in two months.
map.[hota] trial of flame.header.name: Trial of Flame
map.[hota] trial of flame.header.rumor.0: Be ready for the unforeseen problems...
Here they are! The embodiment of a pure fire. Amazing creatures...
I felt powerful magical energy emissions, as if the sun itself was trying to come down from heaven. Unfortunately, I was not so far from above, as phoenixes descended on us from heaven.
I see hundreds and hundreds of bones lying on the sand. Must have been a battle here... I see movement… The Dead Army rises, surrounding my squad.
map.[hota] trial of flame.monster.26.8.0: Surprisingly, I never thought that such a large tribe of nomads can live in such a hostile place.
Mummies, damned to rise from the dead. I read about them, but had never met the creatures before.
map.[hota] trial of flame.monster.31.2.0: It seems that a group of pirates has completely lost their mind and was ready to kill any traveler not for gold, but for water.
Mighty fire demons are blocking my way. Their destruction is one of the key milestones in my journey.
As a token of gratitude, the elemental is ready to give me a collection of scrolls of the Plane of Fire. These scrolls contain secret knowledge.
An intelligent fire elemental lives here. He came here to find his phoenix pet.
Elemental hinted that he might generously reward me, if I find his pet.
map.[hota] tutorial.guards.24.17.1.messa: Well, well! As you approach, you notice several Gnolls guarding an item of no small interest. Do you wish to challenge them? (Hint: don't fret! This won't be hard!)
map.[hota] tutorial.guards.30.32.0.messa: Ahead is an enemy hero guarding the ancient Obelisk. Rumor has it that the Obelisk features part of the puzzle map that should reveal the location of the Grail. We’re getting close...
map.[hota] tutorial.guards.8.33.0.messag: The lights of the Inferno town gleam above you. There is a fort here, which means there are some basic fortifications. To make things easier for you, several Archangels have agreed to back you in battle.
map.[hota] tutorial.header.description: If you have never played any turn-based strategy games in the Heroes of Might and Magic series before, start with this scenario. Here you can learn the basics of the game, including the controls and the interface.
map.[hota] tutorial.header.name: Tutorial
map.[hota] tutorial.monster.17.1.0.messa:
There are special types of terrain that influence the course of combat. For example, bonuses to morale and luck do not apply on cursed ground. 

Ahead, you see several Liches: per your scouts, they are guarding the second Obelisk. Defeat them to clear the way.
map.[hota] tutorial.quest.10.4.0.complet: The guards welcome the news of you having vanquished the hero in the southeast. They agree to let you pass, but warn that the lands on the other side are fraught with danger.
map.[hota] tutorial.quest.10.4.0.firstVi: The cursed ground on the other side is very dangerous. The guards insist: you should first deal with the problems in the southeast, and only then move forward.
map.[hota] tutorial.quest.10.4.0.nextVis: The guards advise continuing along the road to the southeast; you shouldn't venture into the lands on the other side just yet.
map.[hota] tutorial.questEvents.0.questC: "These Griffins will serve us well! You may continue on your way."
map.[hota] tutorial.questEvents.0.questP: The guards won't yield. They advise building a Griffin Tower in the town so you can hire the creatures they demand.
The guards won't let you pass until you bring them several Griffins. They suggest that you should build a Griffin Tower in the nearest town to hire them.
map.[hota] tutorial.sign.23.19.1.message: Signs can also contain useful information. Ahead, you will encounter mines of 4 other types. Capture all of them and keep moving southwest.
map.[hota] tutorial.town.5.5.0.name: Castellatus
Getting back to the boat is not as easy – the pursuing harpies are here already.
map.[hota] upper kingdom.header.descript: Fleeing from pursuing Nighon guards, you find a well hidden cave. Nix live here and while without much enthusiasm, they agreed to shelter you. They also hinted clearly that somewhere near here there is a way out.
map.[hota] upper kingdom.header.name: Upper Kingdom
map.[hota] ville'de'porte.event.1.descri: Landing on the shores of Filato disturbs me a lot, I don’t know a thing about what’s happening on this goddamn isle. Why does it seem to me I’m gonna regret about it? Maybe it’s obscurity of everything around that frightens me? Yet still I feel curiosity fills me, I’m tempted to move to this mysterious impassable jungle. Well, since I’m here, I’m to clear up everything happening.
map.[hota] ville'de'porte.event.2.descri: My crew decided to stay on the ship, these vultures are afraid of plain trees! Okay, I’m gonna endure without’em, considering some Erathians joined me. They have the same question as me in their minds: what happens on the isle? We’d shed light on it and get out of here, my curiosity may not end up well in time.
map.[hota] ville'de'porte.event.3.descri: It’s a bit strange the Erathians don’t even try to return the town of Seviheart. Can it be that “the Great Erathia” is afraid of a bunch of elementals? However, who knows, maybe there’s much more of’em than I think.
map.[hota] ville'de'porte.event.4.descri: Long ago there were many Nighonian villages under this isle, so there are small tunnel nets under the ground. Maybe the Erathians would use it to attack Seviheart.
What could magi have forgotten here? They’re definitely here not for a cup of tea. Unfortunately, nothing prevents them from preparing to battle.
map.[hota] ville'de'porte.guards.16.34.0: Get rid of your former army!
map.[hota] ville'de'porte.guards.19.28.0: Get rid of your former army!
map.[hota] ville'de'porte.guards.21.17.0: Many citizens were hiding from Elementalists and now they were ready to help in freeing the town.
map.[hota] ville'de'porte.guards.28.29.1: Just as expected, the Erathians used the old ways of Nighonians and built their headquarters there, thus making a base for themselves to attack. But their assault failed, and now it’s only left to defeat the remnants of their army (yes, the remnants).
Don’t try to block the road of Christian, otherwise you won’t pass further!
{Delete ALL units that didn't die in previous battles}
map.[hota] ville'de'porte.guards.3.2.0.m: These griffins couldn’t do any harm, but later there can be stronger creatures, so I {can’t lose even one archer}.
map.[hota] ville'de'porte.guards.34.13.1: What’s the use of this sulfur?
Believe me, that’s gonna serve you!
"Manfred? What the hell are you doing here?"
"I was caught in the Elementalists’ trap. You know our brotherhood would never rescue anyone if you won’t promise a reward. I’ve already started to think I’m gonna die in this goddamn prison, if you won’t release me, for sure."
"Gonna do that, but I need your help."
"I’ll help you the way you wish, just release me. You can’t imagine how much I’m sick and tired of sitting here."
map.[hota] ville'de'porte.header.descrip: One of the Erathian headquarters on the Filato isle had used to be a cash cow for smugglers until the whole army of elementals invaded it. Now chaos reigns there, and no one knows what happens there. Fortunately, Bidley navigated by the isle that time.
map.[hota] ville'de'porte.header.name: Ville'de'Porte
map.[hota] ville'de'porte.monster.24.4.1: Now Manfred had to help Bidley in searching the underground. But the Erathian navy is coming very soon, so Bidley is to prepare Seviheart to defense. {When Bidley is ready to defend the town}, Manfred can hit the trail.
map.[hota] ville'de'porte.monster.27.4.1: Now Bidley can hire a small squad to defend Seviheart.
You haven’t forgotten to bring the shackles of war to the seer, have you?
map.[hota] ville'de'porte.quest.2.7.0.fi: It’s simple, you defeat dwarves on the east, you get archers!
map.[hota] ville'de'porte.quest.3.34.1.c: It’s only left to go through the portal far in the tunnel.
map.[hota] ville'de'porte.quest.3.34.1.f: Once the town of Seviheart is safe, you may pass.
map.[hota] ville'de'porte.quest.3.34.1.n: The guards still beware of Edric, so they won’t let you pass.
map.[hota] ville'de'porte.quest.9.32.0.c: Oh, Sword of Hellfire and Vampire’s Cowl is definitely what I need! Here’s the reward I’ve promised. Do you want to take it now?
map.[hota] ville'de'porte.quest.9.32.0.f: I only have {one} gem, so if you bring me a pair of trinkets, I’ll give it to you.
map.[hota] ville'de'porte.quest.9.4.0.co: Ok, you may pass, but remember – not even an archer.
map.[hota] ville'de'porte.quest.9.4.0.fi: You couldn’t have lost the pendant, right?
map.[hota] ville'de'porte.quest.9.4.0.ne: You couldn’t have lost the pendant, right?
In the future, the Avalanche archipelago will only be a part of the huge peninsula. Now the peninsula is only protruding from the water, revealing a fleet of sunken ships, which, naturally, attract treasure hunters of all races and colors.
map.[hota] with sword and fire.event.0.d: You have no gold or resources.
map.[hota] with sword and fire.header.de: There comes a day when even a ranger as legendary as Kyrre can't find her way out of the forest maze. To make things worse, the woods are peppered with traps and riddles. Seeing as elves can't bring themselves to hurt the trees, she will have to hack and burn someone else.
